text:
🍽️✨ Reseña del Restaurante Hawa – Hotel Tambo del Inka, Urubamba

Mi experiencia en el Restaurante Hawa del Hotel Tambo del Inka fue absolutamente excepcional. Desde el primer momento en que ingresas al restaurante, te envuelve un ambiente elegante y acogedor, con una decoración que combina a la perfección lo contemporáneo con detalles inspirados en la cultura andina. Las grandes ventanas ofrecen una vista encantadora a los jardines y al río, creando un entorno tranquilo y armonioso que hace que cada comida sea una experiencia sensorial completa.

El servicio es impecable. Todo el personal demuestra una amabilidad genuina y un profesionalismo admirable. Están siempre atentos a cada detalle, explican los platos con entusiasmo y te hacen sentir como en casa, pero con el trato de un restaurante de categoría internacional.

La gastronomía del Hawa es un verdadero homenaje a los sabores del Perú. Cada plato refleja la riqueza del Valle Sagrado con productos locales y frescos, cuidadosamente seleccionados y presentados con un toque gourmet. La fusión de ingredientes andinos con técnicas modernas da como resultado una experiencia culinaria que deleita tanto al paladar como a la vista.

Probamos varios platos y todos fueron memorables. El cuy confitado y la trucha del Valle fueron espectaculares, con sabores equilibrados y presentaciones impecables. Las entradas con quinua y maíz destacaron por su originalidad, y los postres —especialmente el de chocolate con cacao peruano— fueron el cierre perfecto para una cena inolvidable.

La carta de vinos y cócteles complementa de manera excelente la propuesta gastronómica, con opciones seleccionadas para realzar los sabores de cada plato. Además, el desayuno buffet que se ofrece en el mismo restaurante es de otro nivel: una variedad impresionante de productos locales, panes artesanales, frutas frescas, jugos naturales y estaciones donde todo se prepara al momento.

En definitiva, el Restaurante Hawa es mucho más que un lugar para comer: es una experiencia culinaria de lujo que conecta los sentidos con la esencia del Valle Sagrado. Perfecto para disfrutar en pareja, en familia o incluso para celebrar una ocasión especial.

Recomiendo este restaurante sin dudarlo. Es, sin exagerar, uno de los mejores del Cusco y del Perú, y una visita obligada para quienes buscan disfrutar de la gastronomía peruana con elegancia, autenticidad y calidez.

text: From the moment we walked in, Owner/Chef Eduardo made this meal unforgettable. He didn’t just take our order—he genuinely engaged with us, explaining each dish, offering thoughtful suggestions, and sharing his passion for the food he creates. The cuisine itself is a masterfully balanced fusion of Peruvian, Asian, and world flavors, each plate both visually stunning and delicious. But what really stood out was Eduardo’s hospitality. He brought out little appetizers on his own, sat at our table, and created an atmosphere that felt more like dining with a friend than at a restaurant. The food was exceptional, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and Eduardo’s care elevated the entire experience. If you’re in Urubamba, don’t miss Kampu. This is the kind of place and the kind of chef that reminds you why dining out matters.​​​

text:
We rented 2 bikes for the day to explore maras, salt mines and moray. We tried many places and they couldn’t help (we booked the day before) but Bull House came through, one large Trek hardtail and one small Trek Hardtail for my partner. Amazing communication. They even picked us up with both bikes loaded, drove us to get some more cash for entrance to Moray, and then drove us up to the start at Moray. (This is additional charge if you want the drive up, highly recommended as it’s a few hours cycle if not!) We then we set off on our own. They provided maps, advice and answered any questions we had. The bikes were great, they were great and I would recommend to anyone who wants to rent bikes in Urubamba or Sacred valley. We even got a puncture and they came out to fix, they had to drive an hour round trip to get to us! Amazing people !

Don’t hesitate just book it, way better way to explore than getting a bus/ tour, far more fun and there some great trails, some even with berms and jumps on the way down!

In total we paid 260 soles for the day for both bikes and the drive up to moray.

Bike rental for Sacred valley = Bull house 🔥

They are legends❤️

Through Wilbert,  I came to see the living connection between the deep past of the Inca, and the modern Quechua people, through their ongoing worship of Pachamama (Mother Earth), devotion to family and community, and generosity of spirit. I feel so fortunate to have met Wilbert and his family, and am already looking forward to the day that our paths cross again

text:
Overall Impression: Sierra Sacred Valley is a stunning boutique property that strikes a perfect balance between high-end luxury and authentic Andean charm. With breathtaking mountain views and a resident group of 5 or 6 alpacas roaming the grounds, it offers a serene atmosphere that is ideal for decompression at either the start or end of a Peruvian itinerary.
Service & Dining
The service here is truly first-class—attentive without being intrusive. Due to the resort's remote and peaceful location, most meals are enjoyed at the on-site restaurant. Fortunately, the culinary program is exceptional; the food is flavorful, beautifully presented, and easily rivals top-tier urban establishments.
The Huchuy Qosqo Trek: A Hidden Gem
One of the standout features of this resort is their curated tour programming. I highly recommend the Huchuy Qosqo Trek. It is a roughly 10km hike along an original Inca route—a rare find that I didn't see offered elsewhere. For capable hikers, it is a special, immersive experience that feels far removed from the typical tourist trails.
Strategic Logistics for Machu Picchu
The resort is excellently positioned for those planning a visit to Machu Picchu:
• The Route: It is a quick and easy transfer to Ollantaytambo, where you can catch a direct train. This is a much more efficient strategy than traveling from Cusco, which results in a significantly longer and more exhausting day.
• The Train Experience: I took the First Class service on the way up to enjoy the views and opted for the Prime train for the return. Since it’s dark on the way back anyway, the Prime service is a smart way to manage costs without sacrificing comfort.
Final Verdict
While the property is a premium investment, the quality of the experience justifies the price tag. It is a world-class spot to relax and find your footing in the valley. Highly recommended.

text:
I don’t have many photos, but I had to leave a review because their professional handling of our 31-person group was top-tier. From the booking process to room assignments and luggage logistics, everything was smooth as silk.

When we arrived, every room was already sorted exactly as requested, singles, doubles, kings, all assigned to the right names with receipts and paperwork ready for signature. No mess, no waiting. Even better, when we returned from an excursion from Machu Picchu, all our luggage was already organized in the lobby exactly as instructed, ready to go. For a group this size, that’s five-star service.

The rooms were quiet, and the hot water was excellent (a must!). The location is a bit away from the center, but we knew that beforehand, plus, a Tuk-Tuk only costs 5 Sol and they’re easy to find. The courtyard with alpacas is a great touch, and the staff were genuinely friendly.

The breakfast spread was huge. My only tiny suggestion? I’d love to see some sugar-free yogurt options next time. Other than that, the stay was flawless. Highly recommended!

text:
Localizado no coração ótimo hotel Aranwa Sacred Valley que fica localizado na Antigua Hacienda Yaravilca em Urubamba, aos pés da Cordilheira Andina e aproximadamente a 43 km do Aeroporto de Cusco, as margens do Rio Vilacota,o  UNNO SPA é o primeiro centro de bem-estar e o mais completo e especializado do Peru, possui uma moderna infraestrutura equipada para oferecer diversos serviços, que unem o a tradicional sabedoria Andina e a medicina alternativa, com o que existe de mais moderno em tecnologia cosmética, prestando serviços de alta qualidade, com produtos 100% naturais.
Cercado de muito conforto e belas bela paisagens, o hóspede desfruta de várias opções de terapia, relaxamento e bem estar físico e mental, pois o local disponibiliza sessões de Pilates, Ioga, Zumba, hidratação, Shirodhara, Massagem Ayuevédica, Massagem Abhyanga, Acupuntura, Banho de Hipertermia, Câmara Hiperbárica, Oxigênio Relaxado, Massagens Oriental e Descongestionante, Ritual do Chocolate, Tratamentos Faciais, Eletroterapia, Hidroterapia, Relaxamento, Salão de Beleza e estética, com serviços de cabeleireiro, depilação, manicura, pedicura e outros.
O único ponto negativo é que a sauna e todas as atividades do SPA são cobradas à parte das diárias, o que no meu entendimento seria desnecessário, pois a sauna e algumas comodidades consideradas mais simples, bem que poderiam estar incluídas no valor da diária, que não é baixa.

text: In retrospect, we should have paid attention to the little voice in our heads telling us to turn around and leave right after we had entered. The restaurant had a dark and dingy vibe, smelled a bit dank and was completely empty. The prices were well over the top (higher even than a classy place in Cusco) so we ordered the ceviche and trout main (which turned out to be very similar in nature). The fusion effort didn’t quite fly, but the fish was ample and pretty good, aside from the price gauging. The nail in the coffin for this place was the service. The chef/waiter/owner? was on speaker phone for most of our meal, so we had to listen to a combination of the shmaltzy music and his conversation as our dining backdrop. When we finished, he cleared the table and we indicated that we were complete. Instead of bringing the bill, he proceeded to go outside and start another phone conversation in the road. We waited a while, went to the bathroom etc and eventually I had to go out in the road and wave a credit card in his face to get his attention so we could pay and get out of there. He clearly knew he was out of line as he apologized, but the bad taste was already in our mouths. As it was, we spent over 100 soles to have our least favorite dining experience in the Valley. For a restaurant advertising and charging for a fabulous vibe, this is a fail.

text:
*דיס המלצה על השאנטי בפיסאק*

לפני שבועיים הגענו במיוחד כדי לסגור מקום ליל הסדר וחוהמ.
הייתה לנו אפשרות לסגור במלון ב-60 סול אבל העדפנו להיות באזור של בית חבד כדי שיהיה לנו פסח כשר ושמח.
סגרנו על *חדר 207 עם מרפסת וחלונות  ב-80 סול*, וביקשתי אישור הזמנה בווצאפ כולל המחיר כדי שיהיה מסודר.
שבוע שעבר הבנו שנשאר יותר זמן בפיסאק אז יצרתי קשר עם הפקיד כדי להאריך את השהות ביומיים, זה אושר וכשבדקתי מולו כמה ימים אחכ שכל התאריכים סגורים לנו הסתבר *שהמחיר לילה עלה ל-150 סול* בגלל פסח.
כשניסתי להסביר לו שהגענו מוקדם וסגרנו על חדר ומחיר מסוים ולא הגיוני שפתאום הוא משנה אותו נתקלתי באטימות מוחלטת וחב״ד פיסאק המלכים עשו הכל כדי לעזור.
הצלחנו לגשר על הפער ושוב סגרנו ב-80 סול ללילה.
בגלל שלא היינו רגועים עשינו הזמנה נוספת למלון שאז עלה 60 והתייקר ל-90 אבל הבנו ששמה ככל הנראה לא נתקל בחוסר הוגנות כזה ועדיף שלא נתקע אם יהיו בעיות.

כשהגענו היום לשאנטי אמנם לא היו בעיות במחיר אבל החדר הנחמד שסגרנו מולו ונכתב בהזמנה התחלף בחדר *בלי שום חלון או אוורור* בטענה שאת החדר שהובטח לנו לא נוכל לשלם במחיר שאז סגרנו כי שוב ״עלו המחירים בגלל פסח״.

אז אם אתם מגיעים לפיסאק תדעו שיש אופציות יותר טובות, הוגנות וזולות ואל תסמכו על ההזמנה שלכם בשאנטי אם עשיתם אחת כזאת מראש כי חבל על העוגמת נפש.

text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Truly Exceptional Stay.
Rumi Hotel is one of those rare places you don’t just stay — you feel. From the moment I arrived, the owners’ kindness left me genuinely speechless. Warm, sincere, and deeply caring — the kind of hospitality you simply cannot fake.
The space itself is beautifully authentic, full of soul and calm energy. You walk in and immediately exhale. Everything feels thoughtfully created rather than commercially staged.
Reliable hot water (always a blessing when traveling), and a lovely kitchen setup if you want to cook your own meals — practical details done right.
What stayed with me most is the feeling of the place. Peaceful, grounded, heart-led. You can tell this hotel is run with love, not just business in mind.
If you value authenticity, warmth, and beautiful energy
Rumi Hotel is a gem.
Deeply grateful for this stay. Highly recommended. ✨

text: I had a great 6 night stay at the Ayra Hotel. The staff are amazing, very helpful and nice and made some fantastic breakfasts. The rooms were nice and modern, the location was great, and of course the great views of the Sacred Valley! Recommend to anyone staying in Pisac!

text: Muito aconchegante , limpo , as pessoas muito atenciosas e simpáticas . Atendimento vip .
author: Vera Tabernero

text:
Simplesmente maravilhosa!
Local tranquilo e muito acolhedor. Café da manhã muito agradável feito com muito carinho!
Recomendo!
author: Letícia Cruz

text:
We had a wonderful stay! The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, making us feel welcome right away. The rooms were spotless, and the beds were very comfortable. We especially appreciated having a heater—it kept us warm and cozy throughout our stay.
The view of the surrounding Andes mountains is absolutely magnificent. It is in a nice quiet location with easy workability to the square and the market. Breakfast was delicious, healthy, and filling—a perfect start to each day. The artwork and décor throughout the hotel reflect classic Pisac style, tastefully done with a fun and vibrant atmosphere.
We truly enjoyed our time here and will definitely stay again!
author: NK

text: Mega schöne Unterkunft. Sehr saubere Zimmer, wunderschöner Garten in der Mitte, toll zum Hinlegen. Jeden Morgen feines und frisches Fühstück. Wir würden wieder gerne herkommen ♥️ muchas gracias
author: Magdalena Müller

text:
We had a wonderful time at the Inka Guesthouse in Pisac. The rooms are simple but very clean and comfortable. The staff are extremely kind and friendly, always ready to help with great tips about the area.

The breakfast was absolutely delicious – one of the best we’ve had in Peru! The location of the guesthouse is also excellent, close to everything yet peaceful.

We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back again. We can 100% recommend the Inka Guesthouse to anyone visiting Pisac!!
author: Dirk

text: A really great experience. Over the top helpful. A 3 minute walk to the plaza. Every staff member is incredibly nice and helpful. I would definitely recommend staying there. I would go back for sure
author: J. Wysynski

text:
Tuve una experiencia muy agradable en este hotel. Daniel y Yanet te reciben como si estuvieras en su case! Es un lugar ideal para familias, ya que ofrece un ambiente tranquilo y acogedor donde todos pueden sentirse cómodos. Las instalaciones están muy bien cuidadas y la limpieza es impecable en todas las áreas, desde las habitaciones hasta los espacios comunes. Los cuartos son cómodos y acogedores.

Otro punto a destacar es su excelente ubicación céntrica, que permite acceder fácilmente a diferentes atracciones culturales y disfrutar de la gastronomía local a unos pasos del hotel. De hecho, Daniel y Yanet fueron instrumentales en indicarnos lugares mas lejanos donde pudimos experimentar y enamorarnos de Peru!

Ya estoy planeando mi próxima visita!
author: nilda figueroa

text: We had an absolutely wonderful week long stay at The Tranquility Hotel in Pisac! The rooms were clean and provided such a peaceful atmosphere to relax in after a day of sightseeing in the area. Each morning, the complimentary breakfast was a highlight—fresh, delicious, and the perfect fuel for exploring the Sacred Valley. El Tejano Mexican restaurant, which is part of the hotel had many excellent choices for both Mexican food and pizza. What truly sets this hotel apart is the people. The hosts, Daniel and Yanet, are incredibly gracious and welcoming, making you feel like family from the moment you arrive. That same warmth extends to the entire staff, who were all professional, kind, and attentive to every detail. Daniel was also able to arrange transportation, reservations, and guides to the local attractions making being a tourist much easier. If you're looking for a comfortable and heart-centered place to stay in Pisac, this is it!
author: Mike Thompson

text: Gracias por la experiencia. Fue realmente agradable disfrutar de todos los servicios y de la excelente atención brindada. Todo el lugar transmite calidez y tranquilidad, con espacios muy bien cuidados y un hermoso jardín botánico que complementa perfectamente la estadía. ¡Una experiencia que vale la pena repetir! 🌿✨
author: Royer Arnol Paucar Adrian

text: Fantastic little hotel in the centre of Pisac. We stayed in one of the old rooms with a fireplace which really added to the atmosphere. Good breakfast and friendly staff/owners who don't speak much English but go out of their way to make you feel welcome. I hope to visit again.
author: Dave Edwards

text: The staff is extremely caring. Hot water during limited hours. I am not a vegan, but the included breakfast was still good. The location is delightful with great views from the fourth floor.
author: Nick Thompson

text: Fue nuestro hogar y base  durante 15 dias, nos sentimos en casa 🏡
author: lorena difilippo

text: Виктория- Волшебный специались по работе с телом! Прекрасный человек и жизнерадостный Гид! Мастер Жизни и Профи своего дела!) Рекомендую встречу с ней🎉❤️
author: Владимир Кондырев

text:
Огромное спасибо Виктории за этот невероятный опыт! Видно, что человек по-настоящему горит своим делом. Виктория идеально владеет языками, и это делает прогулку максимально комфортной.
Что особенно ценно — программа не была "шаблонной". Всё было продумано до мелочей: идеальный баланс информации, без перегруза, но и без упущенных деталей. Мы чувствовали, что маршрут подобран именно под нас. Искренне и очень-очень советую!
author: Alex Myaskoveckiy

text: Нашей группе очень повезло, так как нашим гидом была Виктория! Было все продумано до мелочей! Комфортное проживание, вкусная еда, классные магазинчики и маршрут по уникальным местам. Успели по максимуму насладится красотами сказочной страны Перу. Эта поездка останется на всегда в моем сердце ♥️. Путешествуйте с Викой, даже не раздумывайте, сэкономите нервы и время, проверено 😁.
author: Оксана Вострецова

text: Johana, de la agencia GV, nos organizó una intensa y maravillosa semana de tours por la zona sur de Perú. Todos los detalles estaban cuidados, y nos ayudaron en lo que pudieron a gestionar problemas con nuestros vuelos aún siendo un tema ajeno a ellos. Cuentan con conductores muy profesionales, vehículos modernos y limpios, y guías experimentados. Consiguieron que esa parte de nuestro viaje fuera muy satisfactoria.
author: Kara Trace

text: 5 soles
author: John

text: Cusco 5 soles
author: erick

text:
2025年10月訪問

ピサック→クスコのコレクティーボ乗り場です。

クスコまでは5ソルでした。
author: pinya

text: Choquequirao Trek es una experiencia única con maravillosos paisajes un Trek 100% recomendado, al inicio la caminata es un poco difícil pero la experiencia y la vista lo vale todo. 🏕️⛰️❤️❤️
author: Monica Aslla

text: Good pizzas. Very good service & drinks!
author: Vaishakhi Pilankar

text: ロモサルタードのピザがとても美味しかったです！ピザ焼く体験も無料でさせてくれて嬉しかったです。
author: Aoi

text: Good food with some traditional dishes
author: Sebastian Gonzalez

text: Excelente
author: Carla Delgado

text: The food was delicious, the menu was very affordable. I got to eat next to the river. What else can you ask for. Oh yea, the staff was very charming and generous. Highly recommend
author: etienne ouellet

text:
On trouve d'excellentes adresses au Pérou, mais j'ai particulièrement envie de m'arrêter sur ce restaurant. Déjà, quel plaisir de se poser au dessus de la place du village et de se laisser emporter par l'instant... Ensuite arrive la surprise, des lasagnes végétariennes juste exceptionnelle.. la déco, le contenu... Tout est parfait. Quitter ce lieu avec l'envie d'y revenir le soir même. Le filet de truite exquis lui aussi.
Et l'accueil, il est emplis  de bienveillance, souriant et attentionné..
Un grand merci
author: Olivier FAYET

text: Koricancha was our favorite spot in town. We were met with smiles and friendliness everytime we went! The guacamole was so good and the fries were exactly what we needed (ketchup and all!). Couldn't recommend this spot enough 😁
author: pdobbie

text:
Buena comida, precios razonables.
La zanahoria vino algo dura o cruda, pero el resto bien.
author: Sergio Martín Encina

text: The food was excellent and the host (Gonzalo) was very friendly too. We were traveling with a toddler and they were very accommodating to our requests. We tried the Lomo Saltado and the grilled trout and with were excellent.
author: Prithvi Somasundaram

text: Un restaurant élevant les spécialités andines a un niveau gastronomique, l’expérience était parfaite de l’entrée au dessert. Notre serveur était particulièrement attentionné et sympathique, expliquait tout, était de bons conseils.
author: Hadrien Grenacs

text: I’d highly recommend this place. We decided to visit because of its perfect 5-star rating, and it absolutely exceeded the expectations! Don’t look further, just go here when visiting Ollantaytambo.
author: Lotte Jeuken

text: We had such a wonderful experience at this restaurant that I'm already planning tomorrow night's dinner there and know exactly what I will order.  Tonight, we had the sopa de quinua (quinoa soup), maiz con queso (corn with sauteed mushrooms and cheese), guacamole with tequenos stuffed with Andean cheese as dipping sticks, and grilled alpaca skewers.  Each dish was perfectly prepared, mouth-watering, and unique.  This is a family-run business with the sweetest and most earnest couple and their 2 children.  My husband even asked them for extra business cards for our hotel to recommend to other guests - I've never seen him do this in 15 years of marriage!  Leaving the restaurant, I actually felt sorry for the tourists walking past without entering for a meal.  For reference, we ate at Merito in Lima last night and, although a miraculous gastronomic experience, I did not feel compelled to write them a review the way I do tonight.
author: H Chang

text: Came here for an early dinner after a long ride from Cusco, greeted with a warm smile and chose to sit upstairs to enjoy people watching with our meal. Shared quinoa soup, guacamole, queso corn and mushrooms, and anticuchos. Flavors were amazing and felt like a delicious and healthy home cooked meal! Lots of interesting menu options and can’t wait to go back to try them!
author: William Staerker

text: Excelente comida! Fresca, sabrosa y buen precio. Pidan la hamburguesa de alpaca. Exquisita! Y el postre de pie de manzana con helado!
author: Alexander Alfaro Rivera

text: Delicioso "lomo a la piedra", melhor lomo que comemos no Peru, no entanto o atendimento deixou muito a desejar. Coca cola de 600ml servida quente e sem copo a própria atendente me perguntou se eu queria um drink 2x1 no happy hour, ao ser questionado sobre o tamanho dos copos ela me disse que os 2 copos eram do tamanho do copo de drink usual. Ou seja, nao existe happy hour. Infelizmente a experiência nao foi positiva, apesar da deliciosa comida.
author: Igor Fleury

text: Better than many of the great restaurants in Cusco. Had the Trilogia Inka a la piedra. Nice view from the balcony. Highly recommend
author: Eknoor Singh

text: Muy buena atención y la comida exquisita! El lugar muy lindo y con una vista hermosa al pueblo
author: cintia londero

text: Food is good. View is amazing! It was quite pricey for what I got though
author: Tarek El-Gaaly

text:
Lo único malo fue el principio, después de ofrecer un menú de 40 soles con bebida, la bebida dejó de estar incluida. Pero rectificaron y añadieron una limonada y un pan de ajo.
Y los dos platos estaban muy ricos, tanto las dos sopas, como la trucha o el lomo saltado. Y en todos ellos, acompañamientos muy generosos.
Buenas vistas y servicio correcto
author: Joan Font

text: Excellent restaurant and service. I dined here twice because it’s one of the best around the area
author: Amy Chia-li Yu

text: Highly recommend. Local typical food with great quality for the price. Unique atmosphere and owners.
author: Virgen Roy

text:
We got into town super late after a really long flight and found this place was still open and had vegan options.

I am very glad we went here over anywhere else, since my boyfriend suddenly got altitude sickness and every one of them jumped in to help. I was amazed at how they immediately they tried to help my boyfriend feel better with bottled water, fresh air, and a comfy seat. (All of this was closer to closing time too where they could have just gone home if they wanted). It’s rare to see this selflessness nowadays, so I’m so thankful we stopped by!

All in all, before he got sick I had really tasty quinoa soup and my boyfriend who’s vegan got the fried potato dish on the vegetarian section with pickled veggies and rice. That also tasted great!
author: Stephanie Marker

text: Delicioso almuerzo, mi esposo y yo disfrutamos con una deliciosa sopa de quinoa servida en un lindo plato de piedra y de fondo trucha a la piedra acompañada de papas , ensalada y deliciosas salsas, tmb anticucho de alpaca.
author: Luzmaria luzon riveros

text: Gluten free options - super yummy came back three times! Great view too!
author: Shannon Toogood

text: Had an iced latte and the “full bowl” after a long day of hiking. They were so good and the owners were really kind. And we got chocolate chip cookies to go :) They have a huge variety on the menu and it was a perfect spot to hang for a bit!
author: Sophie Golden

text:
Ambiance is nice and friendly servers.

But slow service and food is just ok, nothing exceptional given the high prices.

Had the cheese empanadas and brownie. Both were below average as compared to other food venues in town
author: Faisal Naeem

text: Very good peruvian specialties.
author: Nicolas Fischer (nicofisch5)

text:
Ausgezeichnetes Restaurant mit guter Lage. Aufgrund der Vielzahl von guten Bewertungen sind wir auf das Restaurant aufmerksam geworden - und was soll ich sagen, hat sich sehr gelohnt.
Sehr leckere Speisen, wir kommen wieder.
Preis / Leistung war für die gute Lage hervorragend.
author: Philip K.

text: Delicious & beautifully presented juices, amazing corn soup & great service!
author: Lexi Tichenor

text: Not to be missed, excellent food, perfectly served, surprising and 5 star Peruvian dishes. Glad we ordered a cocktail which was expertly prepared tableside. Hands down our best meal in the Valle Sagrada.
author: Pawel Janowski

text: Our group of 8 had lunch at Amanto Sagrada today after a morning tour of the fabulous Ollantaytambo Inca Temple of the Sun and astronomical site. Bianca took great care of our group. The art work, flowers, and sculpture over the serving area were lovely. A great selection of music provided a good background. The meal was superb! It was beautifully and artistically presented -- and the flavors incredible. Congratulations to Amanto for exceeding our expectations and creating a wonderfully memorable meal in Ollantaytambo. Thank you so very much!
author: Nancy Brian

text:
Exquisito y muy bonito el ambiente.
Nos atendió Eva y su trato fue muy amable y atento.
author: Aaron Gorojod

text: Get the grilled alpaca. Made me a fan …. Almost over beef 😰. So good we went back the following night and both order the grilled alpaca.
author: Brandon Rodriguez

text: Great spot in ollantytambo. I had the stuffed trout and it was amazing. Not bony at all. The presentation was beautiful. The chefs take pride in the food and the staff is wonderful. And the prices are very reasonable.
author: C L

text: MELHOR carpaccio que já comi na vida! Atendimento impecável, lugar charmoso com uma vista linda! Pagamos 35 soles pelo menu turista, recomendo MIL POR CENTO! Vá e não irão se arrepender
author: Amanda Albertoni

text: Estuvimos de visita aquí la semana pasada y la comida estuvo increíble, pero la camarera tenía una mala actitud. Nos lanzaba miradas de desagrado —como si no nos diéramos cuenta— y no empezó a ser amable hasta que llegó el momento de dejarnos su tarjeta y pedirnos una reseña 😂. Pero, dejando a un lado a ella, literalmente todo lo que comimos estuvo fantástico. Definitivamente lo recomiendo. Quizás ella estaba teniendo un mal día. Fue la mejor chicha morada que probamos en la zona, y todo era muy fresco. ¡Los pimientos rellenos son algo que tienen que probar sí o sí!
author: James Gonz

text:
Impecable calidad y atención...Cada plato perfectamente diseñado. Cada sabor y color en su perfecta combinación. Pedimos un menú de 4 pasos con comida peruana. Exquisito sabor
La atención también muy reconocible... Amabilidad en cada atención.

Muchas gracias al mozo Carlos que nos atendió
author: Mariela Martinez Herrero

text: Excellent!!! Delicious local food presented beautifully with care to every detail. A Peruvian delight. Highly recommend. I look forward to when I can return.
author: Janine S

text: Notre serveur a été très respectueux envers nous d'une grande politesse et amabilité. Les plats sont bien cuisinés et très bien présentés
author: Marc

text: A very average pasta with mushroom dish -too smothered in pesto sauce
author: pete

text:
We had an amazing experience: the menu turistico is excellent (40 soles with entrada, plato principal y postre). The dishes were fresh, tasty and delicious. The vegetables and fruits come directly from the owners’ field. The owners are super kind and the atmosphere is relaxed and cozy. I can’t wait to come back here again!
Ps. Try their digestivo a la muña 😋
author: francesca sacchi

text: Itt kifejezetten finom volt a vacsora. Tökleves kiváló. Megkostoltam a tengerimalac sültet is. Kicsi drága de finom
author: Viki Ivanicsne

text: Excelente 👌
author: Michael Cano

text:
The food here is straight-up Michelin level. Every plate looks like a piece of art—the colors and presentation are so stunning that I actually snuck a peek at the kitchen just to see how they do it. To my surprise, the kitchen looks like any regular setup, which just proves that it’s all about the chef’s incredible skill and heart, not fancy equipment.

We came with a group of 31, and even the die-hard meat-eaters among us were blown away. One of my friends even said, "If vegetarian food always tasted like this, I’d give up meat for good."

The flavors are just as vibrant as the colors. Every bite was a 10/10. It’s rare to find a place where the food is this beautiful AND this delicious. An absolute highlight of our trip!
author: Pazu P

text: Unassuming looking, but very tasty food for a surprisingly cheap price. And they didn't ask for a review, so the 5 stars is actually legitimate (unlike many places that push for reviews)
author: Thomas Stur

text: This place is excellent!! Ate here three times during our three day stay in Ollantaytambo. The trout ceviche is fresh and delicious. The beef in the lomo saltado is tender and great. Super friendly, laid-back, authentic atmosphere. Got a free little keychain at the end :)
author: Roberta Lee

text: Amazing food, great atmosphere, amazing service. Best Lomo Saltado i have had yet in peru. Carlos you are doing amazing!
author: Zoe Cox

text: Lovely food!
author: Cara Shields

text: This place is off the square a small walk. We stayed for 3 days and this was one of the best meals we have had here. The chicken was so fresh and tasty.
author: Sean Pease

text: Das Essen ist hervorragend. Lokal befindet sich in einer Marktgasse
author: Marika Thommen

text: We got sick in our trip (both my partner and I ended up at the hospital) and we tried to communicate with them, we communicated only few our later our free cancellation window through booking.com. There was no communication from the hotel, they didn’t tried to find a solution ( e.g changes of dates, voucher for later stay etc…)and just charged our credit card. This is very strict and shows a clear lack of compassion and professionalism. This is the only hotel in our trip in Peru which behaved like this. Disappointing, I would stay away.
author: Luca Naitana

text: See the other reviews. Friendly people, and the place has a nice atmosphere. While having breakfast, the sounds of people having fun with eachother came from the kitchen. Pleasant vibes.
author: Kees de Jong

text: Great service and people who are always willing to help. It’s warm, essential breakfasts, fascinating inside ❤️‍🔥
author: an Domchenko

text:
Estancia fantástica en Apu Lodge. Un lugar muy entrañable, con un equipo súper atento y siempre dispuesto a ayudar.

A pesar de nuestros madrugones, el desayuno estaba siempre listo y cuidado al detalle. Además, nos facilitaron toda la organización (guía, recogidas, etc.), lo que hizo el viaje mucho más cómodo.

Muy contentos. Lo recomendamos 100%.
author: Marta Angulo

text: Spirituality is a lie.
author: Holi

text:
Une expérience personnelle désagréable dû à un manque catastrophique de professionnalisme de la part des équipes. On nous a installé dans une chambre, tout allait bien, on donne nos passeports (ils savent qui nous sommes donc) pour qu’ils fassent le checkin et nous leur donnons un généreux pourboire pour leur gentillesse.
Première chose étonnante, on nous invite à nous reposer dans la chambre mais rien ne nous est présenté, ni les infrastructures, ni les règles relatives aux repas et aux heures de checkout, ni les modalités de déplacement vers la ville.
Nous passons à table au restaurant de l’hôtel et entre l’entrée et le plat principal un membre du personnel vient nous trouver pour nous indiquer qu’il s’était trompé et que nous devions changer de chambre. Soit, un peu déçus mais nous refaisons vite nos affaires, on nous change de chambre. La nouvelle chambre n’est pas propre, des détritus sont présents et des cheveux un peu partout. Le lendemain matin au petit déjeuner, on nous informe qu’ils se sont encore trompés et qui faut changer une nouvelle fois de chambre. Nous refaisons nos bagages pour la 2ème fois et nous voilà dans une chambre sans vue. Pour se faire pardonner, on nous propose une bière le soir (?). Le lendemain au moment du départ, les bières étaient bien notées et à payer sur la facture. Dernière phrase assassine de notre hôte : « vous voulez donner un pourboire ? ». Je suis resté interdit face à l’audace. Considérant le prix payé je trouve que la qualité du service n’est absolument pas au rendez vous. C’est dommage vu l’emplacement idyllique et la vue à couper le souffle. Je vais paraître aigri mais il est trop facile de se reposer sur le lieu pour proposer une expérience moyenne. La vue sur la vallée est splendide, même en dehors de Stardome Spiritual Experience
author: Hadrien Grenacs

text:
En Stardome vives una experiencia distinta, estas alejado de la ciudad, se encuentra en la parte superior de una montaña. Aquí puedes relajarte y escaparte del ruido de la ciudad.

Separe la habitación Snake por una noche ($250), nos recogieron desde Ollantaytambo, fueron flexibles con el check in. (Ingresamos después de las 2:00 pm)
Al llegar, vivimos la experiencia de Hot tub con cena romántica ($160), la comida de esta experiencia fue exquisita y las vistas del valle fueron muy bonitas. Luego subimos al domo a observar algunas estrellas (Tip: Las estrellas suelen verse mejor cuando no hay Luna Llena)
Al día siguiente amaneció lloviendo (Tienes paraguas disponibles para usarlos), tomamos desayuno y salió el sol. Visitamos la granja y el templo del condor, donde nos encontramos con Inti (La alpaca de la granja) y nos pudimos tomar algunas fotos. Luego nos llevaron de regreso a Ollantaytambo (Previa coordinación con nosotros), el check out es las 11:00 am.

La experiencia para nosotros fue muy bonita.

Lo único en lo que podrían mejorar sería en dar mayor detalle en cuanto al uso de las instalaciones (Indicar todo lo que incluye la habitación, entrega de llaves al hacer check in, uso del wifi e indicar todo lo que se puede usar en el espacio de la experiencia Hot tub + cena romántica).

Punto importante es que todas las personas que trabajan aquí son muy amables y serviciales. El chef es excelente, ha sido una de las mejores comidas que probé en Cusco.
Sin duda tienen que vivir la experiencia Stardome.
author: Ronald Alejandro Martinez Sarazú

text: La señora Ana y sus compañeros en el hotel Andenes del inca fueron my atentos y amables. Se coordinó muy bien con nuestras actividades, conductores, y guías para el tour que teníamos programado. Aún hasta nos proveyó de un desayuno. Muchas gracias señora Ana!
author: Efrain Bastida De Jesus

text:
The room was a good size and comfortable overall. The staff were very friendly (thanks Alvaro) and welcoming, which made the stay pleasant.

The breakfast selection was rather limited, but for the price, the hotel was still good value. Overall, it’s a solid option for a one-night stay.
author: Pi

text:
Experiência excelente! O ponto alto foi a hospitalidade: recebemos um upgrade de quarto cortesia que fez toda a diferença. Destaque especial para o **Álvaro**, que foi espetacular e cuidou de cada detalhe.
**Prós:**
* Quarto limpo, organizado e com Smart TV e Wi-Fi.
* Cama aconchegante e banheiro impecável e limpo.
* Café da manhã justo! Custo/benefício.
* Atendimento nota 10 do início ao fim.
**Melhorias:**
* **Quarto 2:** Precisa de cortina blackout (a janela fica ao lado de uma lâmpada externa deixando o quarto claro durante à noite).
* **Água quente:** A temperatura oscila e esfria quando o hotel está mais cheio.
* **Travesseiros:** Poderiam oferecer opções com densidade intermediária.
Recomendo muito e voltaria com certeza!
author: Luis Oscar

text:
We loved staying at this place!
On the day we arrived, I felt a bit ill due to the altitude. The team took care of me like family, bringing me tea and food and showing genuine concern. Alex and the team were incredibly friendly, explained everything to us, and were always ready to help with anything. We truly felt like we were staying with family.

The place and the garden are beautiful—peaceful and a bit hidden, yet still very close to the center of Ollantaytambo.

I hope we can come back one day.
Sarah
author: Sarah Miesler

text:
We had such a great time at this hotel! It’s in a fantastic spot—only a short walk from the main square, but it’s tucked away enough that it stays really quiet and peaceful at night. The courtyard is absolutely beautiful and was easily our favorite place to hang out.
The staff were wonderful, but a huge shout-out to Alex. He was incredibly helpful with our daily plans and made sure we had absolutely everything we needed. As for the rooms, they’re huge and have so much charm, plus the bathrooms are modern with plenty of hot water (which we really appreciated). Breakfast was fresh and delicious every morning, and the whole neighborhood feels very safe and homey to walk around. Honestly, it felt like a little sanctuary
author: Michael Silverman

text:
I stayed with my two teen daughters for three nights in March. Alex and his staff were so accommodating and are genuinely friendly people. They helped organize transport from Cusco and back again. This was a huge weight off my mind.
The hotel is in a great location - it took us just 5 or 6 mins to walk into town and the archaeological ruins. Having the outdoor grassy area with amazing views was so nice to relax in between activities. The breakfast was delicious. The rooms are lovely- we also appreciated the smart tv/streaming channels as an option.
Staying in Ollantaytambo was the best part of our trip - so much to do. Hotel Tierra Inka was the perfect place for our stay. I would recommend as a place to all my friends and family.
author: Niamh Hillman

text:
Chambre confortable, mais problème d’eau chaude régulier, et il n’y a plus d’eau à partir de 22h c’est apparement coupé dans le quartier.
Petit déjeuner excellent : bol de fruits frais yaourt, pain, œufs brouillés…
Service de laverie catastrophique : linge mal voir pas lavé pour certains vêtements, tâche de lessive sur d’autres. Linge rendu humide et non pesé … elle l’a pesé après alors qu’il était encore mouillé. Oubli d’une partie du linge dans la buanderie… le service promet un linge sec et plié : faux nous l’avons retrouvé humide et dans une bassine le tout pour le prix (8soles) du double qu’une laverie en ville (4 soles)
author: Camille Vig

text: Séjour fabuleux, les chambres sont situées au bordd'une rivière. Dormir avec le bruit de l'eau est une expérience incroyable. Edith est une hôte extrêmement gentille, qui m'a attendu le soir lors de mon arrivée tardive. Le petit dej est bio avec de produits frais et faits maison. Je recommande les yeux fermés !
author: benjamin cafora

text: This is a great place to stay. Stan and Edith are amazing hosts, and also make great chocolates on the side. My only regret is we did not stay long enough to see the all the amazing sites. The room was clean and comfortable and the breakfast was delicious. Definitely check this place out if you are staying in Ollantaytambo.
author: Michael Hotchkiss

text:
I stayed at Hotel Samanapaq in the Sacred Valley as part of a group of eight adults (ages 40–50) and unfortunately had a very poor experience.

The property is in significant disrepair and should not be marketed as a hotel in its current condition. The mattresses were extremely thin (with no box spring), resulting in back pain and a sleepless night for several of us. Portable heaters were provided but were not sufficient to properly warm the rooms.

One guest experienced a water leak in her room and discovered visible mold on the ceiling. She woke up with congestion and allergy-type symptoms the following day. During the same stay, the fuse blew in her room while using the hotel-provided hair dryer, leaving her without heat for the remainder of the night.

In my own room, the bathroom mirror was cracked, a nightstand lamp was broken, there was a broken tile under the bathroom sink, and the walls were visibly damaged. Overall, the property felt poorly maintained and, in at least one case, posed a potential health concern.

When concerns were raised with the property owner, the response was unwelcoming. We were told that a room with better beds was available for an additional charge, which was disappointing given the overall condition of the hotel.

In the end, we had to spend a second extremely uncomfortable night at this "motel," as the property manager refused to offer a refund.  Seeing that we had already paid for 7 rooms ahead of time (for 2 nights) through the travel agency, we had no choice but to stay another dreadful night.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I feel it’s important to be honest so other travelers—especially those expecting comfort or celebrating a special occasion—can make an informed decision. This property did not meet basic expectations for comfort, maintenance, or guest care.
author: Carla M. Casas

text: Tolles privatgeführtes Hotel. Zu Empfehlen!
author: Ksenia Ryklin

text: Fantástica  , pessoas e proprietários educados e gentis.
author: Robson Roberto Leandro

text: Beautiful place and service!!
author: Jessica Kim

text: Amazing service and a wonderful experience. Thank you, Katherine.
author: Chellagurkhi Manjunath

text:
I booked a night at Las Qolqas EcoResort in Ollantaytambo to explore the area before starting the Inca Trail, and it delivered exactly what I was hoping for.

Before arrival, the resort reached out to organise a pickup from town, which made things simple. On arrival I was welcomed with a drink, checked in promptly, and given time to sit and take in the gardens before being shown around the property and escorted to my room. The staff explained all the amenities clearly, and I liked that each tent or suite is themed around the flower that surrounds it.

The room itself is well suited to a solo traveller or a couple. There is a private deck at the front with sun chairs overlooking the gardens and surrounding mountains. Inside, the bed was comfortable and the tent was well equipped with a heater and fireplace, which made it feel cosy without losing the eco feel. The bathroom was modern and well finished.

The setting is a standout. The tents are positioned along the river, surrounded by mountains and well maintained gardens, so it feels quiet and secluded without being far from town. I even had a hummingbird in the garden outside my tent, which added to the overall experience.

I opted for the three course dinner on site, which was good and very filling. The portions are generous, so it is worth keeping that in mind.

The staff were consistently helpful and attentive throughout the stay, and that carried through to departure. They organised a car to get me to the train station earlier than their standard schedule, and because I was leaving before breakfast they prepared a takeaway breakfast pack, which was a practical and appreciated touch.

Overall, this is a well run eco resort in a strong location with a peaceful setting and thoughtful service, and it works very well as a stop before or after the Inca Trail.
author: Discover with Daroy

text: Nice but very overpriced. Know what you are getting - there is a spa, with sauna; but it must be reserved, and only one person/room can reserve by the hour.  And of course, you can't reserve before you arrive! So forget about using it, practically speaking.  Dinner is pretty good, but again, know there is nothing 5 star happening here. Rooms are tents, nice but small - the 8 bed tent has little room to stand up. Well located and really pretty location. But grossly overpriced for what you get. Nowhere near the quality of service or facilities for the price. Very Peruvian in that regard. As an update - hot water is solar powered - so shower before 8 PM or do without.
author: Sidney Silhan

text:
An exceptional resort experience from start to finish. The entire property was immaculate, with every detail thoughtfully maintained, and the level of service was truly impeccable. It felt like a perfect blend of comfort and luxury.

After completing the 4-day Inca Trail, this was the ideal place to relax and recharge. The on-site spa was a highlight, offering a much-needed moment of recovery, and every meal I had was absolutely outstanding—beautifully prepared and full of flavor.

I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a luxurious and restorative stay.
author: Robin McFall

text:
Updated March 2026: I’ve been traveling with Heart of Travel (HoT) since 2022, and through their small-group tours I’ve experienced incredible places including Guatemala, Cuba, Ecuador & the Galápagos Islands, Colombia, and Mexico City. I'm super excited to be headed to El Salvador and back to Guatemala later this year!

HoT truly understands how to create meaningful travel experiences filled with magic, joy, and genuine connection. Before joining HoT, I was a solo traveler. Their thoughtfully curated itineraries, intimate group sizes, and exceptional local guides, who bring deep passion and knowledge of their countries, have completely changed how I travel. HoT has turned me into a group traveler in the best possible way.

What truly sets HoT apart is their deep respect for and commitment to the local communities they partner with. Their approach to sustainable travel goes far beyond buzzwords. They intentionally take travelers off the beaten path, creating opportunities to connect with people, culture, and everyday life while ensuring that tourism directly benefits the local communities who make these experiences possible. I am so thankful that I found Heart of Travel!
author: Angelina Parker

text:
This trip totally exceeded my expectations! I had never taken a group trip with strangers before, but with the uncertainty of travel in Cuba, this was a solid option to explore the island. I'm so grateful I went and didn't put it off (November 2025)! The situation in Cuba has changed so quickly.

While in Cuba, I felt safe the whole time, catered to by Paloma, Yeni, Pablo and the other kind and welcoming guides we had taking care of us. The group of travelers were also really fun and interesting people, many of whom I still am in touch with.

Since I usually travel on my own, I usually cut corners, but on this trip the food was amazing, the lodging was fancier than I expected and there's no complaining about traveling the entire time in classic cars. The amount of down time to rest and explore individually was perfect and I there was flexibility if we needed it. I could get used to this kind of a trip an 1000% would do it again :)

text: This travel company is special. After only one trip with them they already feel like family. The customer service is excellent- extremely receptive and responsive. The inclusions on the trips are amazing- you literally don’t have to worry about anything but enjoying yourself. I highly recommend and can’t wait for my next trip.

text:
The tour was overall fantastic. Roger was exactly the kind of guide we were looking for: a serious, highly professional, and dedicated leader who exceeded all our expectations. It is rare to find someone with his level of expertise and passion; he was undoubtedly the best guide we encountered during our two-week journey in Peru.
We particularly appreciated how the itinerary was managed. The tour was structured exactly as we wanted, allowing us to dedicate the right amount of time to each site. We never felt rushed, and we truly valued avoiding the typical 'hit-and-run' tourist approach.

Additionally, our driver Mario was excellent—always professional, kind, and polite.

We rate this tour a 5/5 (Amazing).

text:
Passamos dois dias com o Eddy pelo Vale Sagrado.

Além das incríveis experiências de aventura, feitas no hotel Vertical Sky, também tivemos a oportunidade de fazer um Pachamanca com toda a tradição local.

Nos dois dias de passeio visitamos as ruínas e locais tradicionais, porém alcançando lugares que os turistas não costumam ir, passeando por caminhos Incas, conhecendo a história do ponto de vista de um guia local.

Recomendo muito a empresa, tanto para as aventuras (tirolesa, ponte e via ferrata), quanto para o serviço de guia.

Se tiver tempo agende a experiência do Pachamanca, foi realmente muito especial.

text:
Ronny, the man, the myth and the legend did not disappoint. We did the Ollantaytambo ruin tour with Ronny, and he was extremely well read, knowledgeable and experienced as a tour guide. We would not have learnt as much about Ollantaytambo ruins and the town itself without his explanation.

Throughout the tour, Ronny spoke in excellent English and was extremely friendly. Again, he blew our expectations out of the water. He was professional, knowledgeable and soon became a great friend. For those skeptical of the agency and how they don't have a website and are Whatsapp only (like us, initially) ... look at all these positive reviews that have been left. They do not lie. Book a tour with Ollantaytambo Explorer. You will not be disappointed.

Thank you Ronny for the amazing experiences!!
author: Harry Lau

text:
This place is acceptable but one can definitely do better.

I arrived on a Friday when there was a weekend-long festival in town. Many places were booked up and this does sport a convenient location with an admittedly beautiful terrace, so hey.

The rooms seem overpriced for what it is. I was on the third floor and wifi was basically unusable most nights. Even the cellular data I purchased for my phone was poor within my room, but fine outside of it.

The restaurant was strange. Rarely opened for breakfast. I tried to get dinner there once and ordered three things. The one thing that came was delicious but after waiting for almost an hour I gave up on the other two things coming.

The room didn’t seem overly clean. I noticed some remnants of other guests (half used shampoo packets) and general dirt/debris in places as well as a sticky floor.

For a small town Ollantaytambo is oversaturated with places to stay. In all honesty I would definitely stay elsewhere if I was ever back.

text:
Wir haben mit Ernesto eine Tour durch die Ruinenstätte in Ollantaytambo gemacht und waren rundum begeistert. Er hat sich viel Zeit genommen und man hat sofort gespürt, wie sehr er für das Thema brennt – das war wirklich erfrischend.

Statt uns einfach „durchzuschleusen“, wie man es bei vielen großen Gruppen beobachten kann, hat Ernesto alles ruhig und verständlich erklärt. Dabei hat er unglaublich viele spannende Details vermittelt – genau die Art von „Klugscheißerwissen“, die eine Führung erst richtig besonders macht.

Die Tour war jeden Cent wert und wir können ihn uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen. Vielen Dank, Ernesto!
author: T KS

text:
Ernesto hat uns zufällig am Eingang der Inka-Stätten in Ollantaytambo angesprochen und uns seine Nummer gegeben, da wir zu dem Zeitpunkt keine Zeit für eine Führung hatten. Am nächsten Tag sind wir spontan vorbeigegangen – ohne vorher Bescheid zu sagen. Er war nicht da, kam aber nach unserer Nachricht innerhalb weniger Minuten extra für uns zurück. Das fanden wir wirklich bemerkenswert.

Die Tour selbst war sehr individuell und angenehm ruhig, obwohl viel los war. Ernesto hat alles so gestaltet, dass wir genug Raum hatten, Fragen zu stellen und die Orte in Ruhe zu erleben. Sein Wissen ist beeindruckend und er erklärt alles verständlich auf Englisch.

Besonders schön war zu merken, wie sehr er für die Inka-Kultur und die Berge brennt – das hat die Führung wirklich besonders gemacht. Er hat sich viel Zeit genommen, uns auch weniger besuchte Bereiche gezeigt und nebenbei tolle Fotos von uns gemacht.

Auch danach war er noch erreichbar und hat uns bei Fragen weitergeholfen – absolut nicht selbstverständlich.

Klare Empfehlung: Wenn ihr in Ollantaytambo seid, fragt nach Ernesto – es lohnt sich!
author: Ola

text: Hemos hecho el tour completo de Ollantaytambo con Ernesto y ha sido la mejor decisión que podríamos haber tomado! Súper amable, profesional, ha respondido a todas nuestras dudas. Se conoce bién el lugar y ha compartido con nosotras toda su sabiduría. Totalmente recomendable!

text: Wir haben zu zweit eine Tagestour zu Pisaq, Moray und den Salzminen Maras gemacht. Unser Guide war super nett. Er hat uns sehr sehr viel erklärt und viele Fragen beantwortet. Das Tempo der Tour war super angenehm, nicht zu schnell und nicht zu langsam. Wir konnten jederzeit auf dem Weg anhalten oder stoppen. Der Guide hat viele schöne Fotos von uns gemacht. !!!

text: We just returned home to Colorado USA and are so glad we chose Ruben and Maras Moray Tours. We had a fantastic experience on the Short Inca Trail and Sacred Valley tour with Ruben and driver Carlos. In the Sacred Valley, we visited Chinchero, Maras, Moray, and Ollantaytambo, with plenty of time at each stop and informative context to match the beauty of the sites. The Short Inca Trail and Machu Picchu were unforgettable, with Ruben pointing out great photo spots and sharing fascinating history. They booked all our Machu Picchu circuit reservations at ideal times—something we never could have navigated on our own. The accommodations they arranged suited us perfectly, they were always on time, and they provided excellent advice for the rest of our travels. We’re grateful to Ruben and his team for making this trip one we’ll always remember. If we return to Peru (hopefully!!) we will not hesitate to book this company again.

text:
Yes, this is definitely a spot designed for tourists, but it’s actually well worth the stop. We spent over an hour here and our group really enjoyed it.

The demonstration of the weaving and dyeing process is fascinating. They showed us live how they use parasites (cochineal) to create vibrant red dyes, and how adding something as simple as lemon juice changes the acidity to create yellows and oranges. It’s a great hands-on way to understand local traditions.

Of course, there is a shopping area at the end, but the staff were not pushy at all. They give you the space to look around, and the prices are quite reasonable compared to other places. If you want to learn about the history behind these beautiful textiles without feeling pressured to buy, this is a great place to visit.

text:
Durante nuestra visita a Chinchero, incluimos una experiencia exclusiva en el centro textil Manos Andinas, una propuesta de cultura viva cuidadosamente seleccionada por su autenticidad y calidad, muy por encima de las textilerías convencionales de la zona.

A diferencia de los espacios tradicionales, aquí el viajero se conecta realmente con el legado andino, participando de una experiencia interpretativa donde artesanas locales comparten, de manera cercana y genuina, las técnicas ancestrales del tejido, los procesos naturales de teñido y el profundo significado cultural de cada diseño.

El entorno eleva aún más la experiencia: desde este privilegiado punto se aprecia una vista panorámica excepcional hacia la Laguna Piuray, creando un escenario perfecto para disfrutar con calma y tomar fotografías memorables.

Como valor añadido, el lugar cuenta con un espacio especialmente acondicionado para picnic, ideal para quienes buscan una pausa diferente, en contacto con la naturaleza y lejos de los circuitos masivos.

Una experiencia pensada para viajeros que buscan autenticidad, tranquilidad y una conexión real con la cultura andina.

I know in my heart it was by Divine design that I made it to Sacred Valley Spiritual Retreat when I did. We’re in the era of ascension—if you feel the call, answer it.

text: It was a magical time for my first visit to Mount Shasta. I had reached out to Alan and Dianna about visiting them in Ecuador. By serendipity, we learned that we were all in California at the time and decided to meet in Mount Shasta for a weekend of personal healing and reflection. From the very beginning of our interactions, I sensed a welcoming and kind nature from Alan and Dianna. They helped create a personal itinerary for me. We did different forms of healing, including: reiki, hypnosis, meditation, and shamanic work. Each experience was unique and very helpful. We also spent time on the Mountain and also visited beautiful waterfalls. By luck, it was also lion's gate portal and a full moon. I thoroughly enjoyed my time in Shasta and highly recommend Alan and Dianna for their healing work. They both made me feel safe and welcomed and have helped me tremendously.
author: Rania Karkar

text:
Before I even arrived, I felt held. As a petite woman traveling solo, I had initial hesitations about journeying to Ecuador—but Alan and Dianna made every step feel effortless. From airport pickups to local transitions, their care and clarity dissolved my fears. I felt safe, supported, and gently guided from the moment I said yes.

I’ll admit, I was obsessed. I kept circling back to their website, drawn to something I couldn’t quite name—Alan’s presence, Dianna’s warmth, the valley itself. It felt like a soul-level invitation. After meeting them over Zoom, I knew. There was no pressure, no persuasion—just a loving suggestion to read Alan’s book and see if it resonated. It did. Deeply. I even left a review on Audible. Within days, I secured my space.

What struck me most was how personalized everything was. There was no rigid schedule or group format. The retreat was shaped entirely around me—my timing, my needs, my healing. I was welcomed into a spacious, private guest house with every amenity I could need. I had room to breathe, reflect, and integrate, yet Alan and Dianna were just steps away whenever I needed support.

The experience itself? Beyond words. The Ayahuasca ceremonies were profound, but what truly set this apart were the co-modalities they offered—breathwork, energy healing, trauma release, and more. It was a full-spectrum journey designed to help me shed layers of density and open fully to the medicine.

Alan and Dianna held me with such compassion and presence. I felt safe, seen, and deeply supported—not just during the retreat, but afterward too. Their integration support continued once I returned home, helping me anchor the transformation into my daily life.

I can’t imagine experiencing Ayahuasca for the first time in any other format. This wasn’t just a retreat—it was a homecoming. I feel whole. I feel peace. I feel love.

I’m eternally grateful to Alan and Dianna. This may just become my annual pilgrimage.

text:
I recently brought a group of women to El Verde Peru, and as a retreat leader who has been guiding retreats for the past six years, I can honestly say this experience was one of the very best.

Jyl has thought of every detail and has created a space that feels warm, welcoming, and---well, magical. From each thoughtfully prepared meal to the around-the-clock availability of specialty teas and the cozy nightly fires in the fireplace, we felt deeply cared for every step of the way. The rooms were spotless, yet cleaned daily to maintain a level of cleanliness that is above and beyond anything I have experienced before.

The gardens are stunning. Each day we discovered something new... a hidden nook, blooming flowers we missed the day before, hummingbirds moving through the space, a surprise around every flower! The land, surrounded by the mountains, feels alive and intentional. Set in a small, rural community, we felt both part of a community but also experienced the quiet needed when on retreat.

The Sacred Valley is powerful on its own, but what Jyl has created at El Verde truly elevates the experience of being there. There is a sense of care in every corner of the property. It allowed our group to settle in, connect with one another, and fully receive the beauty of Peru... and as a retreat leader, I couldn't hope for anything more!

I would return in a heartbeat (in fact, I'm looking at just when we might go back right now!).
author: Jennifer French

text: Just returned from an awsome yoga week at El Verde.  The owner, Jyl, is a kind soul who worked very hard to quietly allow the week to unfold in a peaceful & powerful experience. text:
Don’t hesitate for a second — this place is truly special. From the moment you walk through the door until the moment you leave, you feel embraced, cared for, and renewed. If you’re looking to detox your mind, body, and spirit, this is exactly where you need to be.
Surrounded by the breathtaking Andes mountains, the energy here is on another level. The service is exceptional — heartfelt, attentive, and far beyond what you’d expect, even from a 5-star hotel. The Arbol Team genuinely makes you feel seen and supported.
Between the meditation sessions, yoga, cleansing programs, and spa treatments, every day feels like a gift to yourself. You’ll not only detox — you’ll learn how to truly care for your body. The food is completely organic, fresh, and delicious.
I had one of the best experiences of my life here. I would recommend this place endlessly. You arrive as a guest… and you leave feeling like family. Thanks Arbol Team!

text:
A Life-Changing Experience, Deeply Healing and Beautifully Held!

I recently attended this ayahuasca retreat that has truly changed my life. From the start, the team put incredible thought into preparing us for the ceremonies. The workshops are thoughtfully curated to give you the tools and mindset to enter the experience feeling ready, grounded, and open. Everything is designed with intention.

We had powerful sessions exploring childhood trauma and identifying our trauma responses, which gave me a deep understanding of my emotional patterns. Another workshop around victimhood helped shift my perspective and reclaim my personal power. We also had group-building workshops that created a real sense of safety and connection, making it easier to open up and share authentically throughout the week.

Nina’s yoga sessions are a highlight. Gentle, grounding, and always adapted to the group’s needs. Her deep presence and intuition extend into the music she curates for the ceremonies. The sound journey she creates is powerful, striking a perfect balance between being emotionally moving and deeply enjoyable. It acts as a beautiful guide throughout the experience.

Before the ceremonies, you also have access to wonderful bodywork like massages to reconnect with yourself, which I found incredibly helpful. There are even laundry services for those arriving from long travels. These small touches make a big difference in feeling at home and supported.

During the ceremonies, Hector’s presence brings a strong sense of safety and calm. His experience is clear, and his gentle guidance, especially around the first hour mark or the booster time, makes you feel held and cared for throughout the journey.

Lais takes care of everything behind the scenes with such attention and kindness. If you have a logistical issue or feedback, she’s there to ensure it’s taken care of immediately. And then there’s Miro, whose spontaneous conversations somehow always land with clarity and insight, helping you make sense of your journey in subtle and profound ways.

The food deserves a mention too, healthy, fresh, locally sourced, and absolutely delicious. You truly feel nourished on every level.

This retreat helped me process deep grief, become more aware of patterns in my life, and gain closure on past traumas. The environment, the people, and the structure created a container that felt incredibly safe, loving, and transformative.

If you're considering an ayahuasca retreat, I wholeheartedly recommend this one. It is not only deeply healing but also thoughtfully and beautifully facilitated from beginning to end.
author: aline neven

text:
This retreat was one of the most meaningful and well-organized experiences I’ve had. The setting was beautiful, the food nourishing, and the ceremonies and workshops were thoughtfully planned to support real inner work.

The Ayahuasca ceremonies were led with care and presence. I really appreciated how Hector created a sense of connection by calling us "family" and regularly checking in with us. Being able to sit under the stars during the night ceremonies was especially powerful. The workshops like Childhood Regression, Victimhood, etc. were also a key part of the process. They helped prepare the ground for deeper experiences during ceremonies and gave us tools to make sense of what was coming up. The yoga and breathwork added a lot as well, supporting both body and mind through the journey.

This retreat offers a rare and supportive space for personal healing and growth. It feels genuine and well held. Overall, it was a deeply valuable journey, and I’d recommend it to anyone ready to do honest, inner work and reconnect with themselves.
author: Soul Cartographer

text:
I would like to thank the staff for their caring and support throughout the whole retreat. They created an inspirational and safe place. I remembered their calm walk, as they were keeping an eye on us during ceremonies. It was a feeling of safety and comfort. Selection of songs during sessions, made up of both softer and harder ones maintained the right atmosphere. Especially songs from Hans Zimmer.

I enjoyed the day ceremony outside in the garden the most. There was a moment when the long-accumulated anxiety and fears inside me seemed to fall away suddenly and I could’t stop laughing out loud for several minutes. It was a relief I hadn’t experienced in a long time.

Besides ceremonies I really enjoyed the art sessions where I could express my insights. Yoga classes were really useful due to my lack of movement and I have learned that yoga isn’t just about physical stretching muschles but contains also other deeper aspects.

At one of the workshops I learned something new about the roles in victimhood triangle. There were a lot of useful info that you can integrate into your life after the retreat.

Oh and I have to mention the dishes, every meal was delicious despite being mostly vegetarian.

The whole retreat concept was well-tuned and I experienced an unforgettable week. Big thanks for that opportunity.

text:
During my months of traveling through South America I have done many guided tours — but the Salkantay Trek was one of the most unforgettable thanks to the Machu Picchu Expeditions team, and in particular because of our incredible guide Tupac. It is hard to fully describe how much enthusiasm, humor, knowledge, and care that Tupac put into our tour, constantly going above and beyond (and at one point even lending his own shoes to a trekker). Plus, we are so grateful that we were put in Tupac’s group, because it seemed like compared to the other trekking companies we were always the ones having the most fun ☺️

Additionally, the food was unlike any food I had ever had on a hiking tour. I was expecting chicken and potatoes for every meal, and so I was very pleasantly surprised when we got to have restaurant-quality meals, including dishes like trout and mango ceviche.

Finally, the horseman was fantastic, ensuring that our duffels and supplies were safely delivered to our accommodations each day.

Thank you to the entire MP Expeditions team for making our time on the Salkantay Trek so memorable — will be strongly recommending this company to all of my friends.

My only recommendation to the company is to offer a one page PDF with all of the important details/logistics for the Aguas Calientes / Machu Picchu day, including the return to Cusco. There were a lot of things to remember, and it would be helpful to have it all written to avoid confusion.
author: Lauren Kearns

The owner and guide were very attentive and friendly, and communication in English was completely smooth. I highly recommend this excellent small local company.

text:
We booked a Sacred Valley day trip with Peru Summit Adventures and it was, without a doubt, the highlight of our entire time in Peru. From start to finish, every detail was taken care of and we left with memories we’ll cherish forever.
Our tour guide Simon was absolutely world class. His knowledge of the Sacred Valley was impressive and his energy was infectious throughout the day. What truly set him apart was his genuine care for the people he was guiding - he went out of his way to facilitate a very special moment for my fiancé and me, something we will never forget. If you’re lucky enough to have Simon as your guide, you’re in for a treat.
Our driver Juan was equally fantastic - professional, reliable, and a pleasure to be around. He made every transfer smooth and comfortable.
We came away having learned so much about the history and culture of the Sacred Valley, and we had an absolute blast doing it. If you’re visiting Peru, do yourself a favor and book with Peru Summit Adventures. You won’t regret it!
author: Thomas J

text: If you are planning to visit Cusco or any of the many amazing attractions in and around Cusco, including everything from Machu Picchu to Rainbow Mountain and beyond, I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND Peru Summit Adventures! They are incredible! I sent my wish list to Carlos and he turned it into a full detailed itinerary for me that was flawless! Our driver, Percy, picked us up at the airport in Cusco and took us to the hotel when we arrived late in the evening the first night. Then the next morning, Percy and our tour guide Simon picked us up at the hotel to take us to the Sacred Valley and had several amazing stops along the way including the Moray Ruins, Maras Salt Mines, the Ollantaytambo Fortress and more! They dropped us at the hotel in Ollantaytambo at the end of the first day and gave us a great restaurant recommendation for dinner. Day 2 we took the train to Aquas Calientes and then the bus to Machu Picchu where Simon guided us through with an awesome tour of the archeological site. We then tried to take the train back to Ollantaytambo but a cargo train had derailed and the trains were down the rest of the day. But Simon and Carlos helped us find a great hotel for the night there rather than waiting it out with hundreds of people in the train station and they also took care of getting our train tickets changed for the next morning. Day 3 after we took the train back with Simon to  Ollantaytambo, Percy was there waiting for us to take us to the Pisaq Archeological Ruins and the town of Pisaq where Simon guided us through the ruins and then down the mountain and into the town before they took us back to our hotel in Cusco for the night. Finally, the next morning, Percy came to take us to the airport for our return flight to Lima. Percy and Simon were awesome!!!! The entire experience was incredible and they took care of EVERYTHING for us each day with the logistics, tickets, transportation, tours, etc. Carlos recommended great hotel options for us as well which was the only thing we had to book ourselves. We opted for a private tour so it was just the two of us with the same driver and tour guide throughout the trip. And everywhere we went, so many people knew our tour guide Simon and stopper to say hello to him and he said hello to many people along the way as well. Worth every penny! Best travel experience with any tour company I’ve ver had and they handled so many details for our three days in the Cusco area! Thank you so much Carlos, Simon, and Percy and the entire Peru Summit Adventures team!

text:
We did a 21 mile ride through sacred Valley. It was gorgeous! I was riding through ancient farmland, past fields of fluffy llamas, down by the river with black pigs wallowing in the mud, children on the mountain side with their llamas. We saw families working on a small plot of potatoes. Rode up high above the ruins Moray.   Got an amazing birds view there.

Rode through the tiny town and had a lunch included a delightful overlook. Appetizer, entrée, drink, dessert included .

The restaurant had a big green grass lawn and tasty food. Clean bathrooms with toilet paper and soap. Then we continued further in sacred Valley to the salt mine. We could see it from far above and then dropped all the way down to the salt mine and were able to walk around and get free salt and buy some salty chocolate.

There is some double track in beautiful country. A lot of single track. It definitely had some gnar and spice. Lots of downhill. Fast and exciting. For me this is the absolute best way to see sacred Valley… Rolling on two wheels!

We were visiting from Utah and mountain bike all the time.  we don’t get to see giant agave bushes and wallowing pigs and llamas and Peruvians in their traditional dress at home! SOOOO FUN.

text:
Desorganización e incompetencia.
No recomendamos a la agencia Inka Trail Backpacker para realizar el camino Inca en un día, porque hemos tenido una experiencia muy negativa.
1. Nos han puesto problemas con el pago en dólares retirados de un banco en España.
2. El hotel en Aguas Calientes no se ha ajustado a la calidad del servicio pagado.
3. Hemos tenido que reclamar a la agencia con insistencia a través del guía que se respetará el horario de vuelta  a Ollantaytambo en un tren anterior por el que hemos abonado un dinero extra.
4. La agencia no ha coordinado el servicio de recogida en la estación para nuestro traslado a Cuzco, con lo que hemos tenido que esperar más de 45 minutos a otro conductor al que han avisado a última hora.
5. Y, lo peor de todo, no han dado la cara para resolver todos los problemas.

Lo único positivo el guía, Ulrich (freelance, por cierto), que ha sido un gran profesional y ha estado pendiente de nosotros todo el tiempo, incluso solucionando lo que no le correspondía.

text:
Wir haben den 5-Day Salkantay Trek gemacht. Alles war top organisiert: das Vorab-Meeting hat bei den letzten Fragen geholfen, das Gepäck war stets pünktlich an den Unterkünften und uns fehlte es an nichts. Das Essen war meist abwechslungsreich. Nach einem Tag, wo die Veggie-Option mittags und abends Ei war, wurde es die folgenden Tage noch vielfältiger.
Die Unterkünfte waren so luxuriös wie es zum Campen geht.
Ich fand’s auch gut, auch Sicherheitsgründen (Erdrütsche) lieber einen Abschnitt des Treks zu überspringen, als stumpf durchzuziehen.
Bei der Gruppengestaltung wird sich auch gut Gedanken gemacht: wir waren 5 Paare im ungefähr gleichen Alter.
Auch super: mit Machu Picchu Tickets für 6am waren wir vor den großen Menschenmassen vor Ort.
An der ein oder anderen Stelle hätte jedoch besserer Informationsfluss stattfinden können:
Dass die Abholung morgens zu Fuß stattfand, hat mich zu der Uhrzeit doch etwas überrascht und kalt erwischt. Ich war mit offenen Schuhen nicht darauf vorbereitet, mein gesamtes Gepäck noch 5 Minuten zum Auto zu tragen.
Für den Besuch der Thermalquellen hieß es, wir bräuchten nur Schwimmsachen. Und plötzlich musste ich in Flipflops noch einen Kilometer pro Strecke wandern, auf dem Rückweg dann im Dunkeln. Bei rutschigem Untergrund mit ein bisschen bergauf und -ab hat das leider wenig Spaß gemacht.

text:
We did the 6-day Salkantay Trek & Short Inca Trail, and it was honestly one of the best weeks ever.

Our guides, Juvenal and Roger, were absolutely fantastic—so knowledgeable, friendly, and fun. They made the whole experience feel seamless and got us all up to the Salkantay Pass without any issues.

The accommodation, food, and overall hospitality were faultless. We especially loved the Jungle Domes and the views from the Sky Camps—each camp was completely unique and special in its own way. Some even had private bathrooms and hot showers, which felt like such a luxury after long trekking days.

For the final two days, it was just the two of us as the rest of the group were doing a shorter trek. We spent one of the longest (and most incredible) days trekking with Roger through stunning landscapes before arriving in Aguas Calientes. There, he handed us over to Juvenal, who guided us along the Inca Trail. Thanks to his expert timing, we had some of the Inca ruins completely to ourselves—such a special experience. We ended our adventure with a private tour of Machu Picchu in the sunshine, which was the perfect finale.

Everything—from hotel pickup in Cusco to being dropped off again six days later—was perfectly organised and completely stress-free.

I can’t recommend this company or this specific trek enough. If you want the full Salkantay experience but also the chance to hike part of the Inca Trail and arrive at Machu Picchu through the Sun Gate, this is 100% the one to book.

Weather-wise, we went at the end of March and experienced a mix of rain and sunshine. I was a bit unsure how the rain might affect things, but it really didn’t at all. Days were warm, nights were chilly—pretty ideal trekking conditions overall.
