text: Contratamos quatro passeios com a Inti: City Tour,  Vale Sagrado, Montanha Vinicunca e Laguna Humantay. Fechamos os passeios direto na agência e fomos bem atendidos. Todos ocorreram da melhor forma possível, pontuais nas retiradas e retorno, com guias excelentes que fizeram as experiências ainda melhores. Parabéns e obrigado aos guias Alfredo, Romário, Jesus e uma moça que infelizmente não me lembro do nome (City Tour) que além de compartilharem muitas informações históricas e interessantes, eram engraçados e otimizaram os passeios de forma que pudesses aproveitar ao máximo, visto que todos são muito corridos devido as distâncias, quantidade de paradas, etc... Recomendo muito a agência, possui um ótimo custo benefício ! Apenas como um conselho para melhoria da empresa, tivemos um pouco de dificuldade de comunicação pelo whatsapp antes de fechar os passeios, o que nos deixou um pouco apreensivo visto que já estávamos em Cusco. Também em relação ao passeio do vale sagrado, para as pessoas que vão permanecer em Olantaytambo para seguir a Machu Picchu se possível não precisar levar elas para a estação de trem ou hotéis, visto que a cidade é pequena e isso acaba atrasando a última parada que é Pisac. Mas de nenhum forma desqualifica a ótimo experiência no geral que tivemos.

text:
What can I say about Guido. He was literally the saving Grace for us in Cusco. He took us everywhere did everything we asked of him and did it all with a smile. He arranged for all sorts of things that were not part of just driving us to point a and point b. Without him we would have had to drive our little rental car over some insane mountain roads. Just imagine you driving a little sedan 2 in away from a cliff that drops down thousands of feet. I really think you want the most experienced driver you can get. And that's Guido. We saw everything there was to see in the region thanks to him. He never rushed us and always had a fun anecdote about the area or the place we were visiting.

I found him ththroufh the Airbnb host that uses him for all of her clients. She herself uses him as a driver because he knows the area so well that in local can appreciate that knowledge. His vehicle is a well-equipped Mitsubishi 4x4. We were a family of two adults and two teenagers, and we all fit comfortably inside his SUV. I have no point where we scared by his driving, as he is very responsible and respects all laws and rules of the road. Which is not something that everyone else does while you go on trips with Guido. He's there early not just on time, he plans ahead and cleans his vehicle after every single trip that you take with him. So the next day you're going back on a slick and clean ride. He treats adversity with a smile and charges honest fees for his services.

Do not be afraid about the language barrier. If you point and show him the places you want to go he will get you there for a fraction of what those so-called "tour guides" that speak crap English and really don't have any knowledge of anything nor any business giving you a tour. That's why having a knowledgeable driver will get you really far in the Cusco area.

I consider Guido a friend after all the experiences we shared over the week or so that we traveled with him.

text:
I feel deeply grateful for the time I was able to work with Luca.
What started as a short visit unexpectedly became almost three months of shared process, learning and transformation.

When I first planned to come earlier, life delayed my journey and looking back now, I clearly feel that I arrived exactly at the right time. Luca met me with presence, patience and a very grounded, supportive energy throughout the whole experience.

His ceremonies are strongly guided through sound. He works with traditional icaros and a wide range of instruments that create a very immersive and safe space. His voice and music helped me connect more deeply with my own process and supported emotional release and integration in a very natural way.

What I appreciated especially was the balance between ceremonial depth and human warmth. Luca holds space with sincerity and respect, and he stays available between ceremonies to support reflection and integration.

For me, this work created meaningful changes in my inner landscape and how I relate to my life.

I’m grateful not only for the healing work itself, but also for the connection that developed along the way. I truly hope our paths cross again in the future.

If you feel called to work with plant medicine and are looking for someone who combines musical depth, sensitivity and integrity in his work, Luca is a beautiful guide to walk part of that path with.
author: Google Reviewer

text:
From the moment we considered booking with Healing Tree, we were treated so well. At first we spoke with Italo, he helped us prepare, understand what we were doing, a 3 day Huachuma ceremony. We were delayed a day due to flight issues and they were very accommodating allowing us to shift everything a day, telling us not to stress, remain calm and it will all work out perfectly.
When we arrived, Alfredo came to our airbnb and helped us with the salt water cleanse, further explaining the next steps and process for the ceremony. He was so knowledgeable and very kind. After our retreat he also met us and made sure we made it to our next Airbnb. He offered us any recommendations should we need it. And we did take him up on that with help arranging a driver to tour the sacred valley at our own pace, and a delicious local cuisine restaurant. Alfredo was truly wonderful.
When we arrived at the retreat, we were met by our host Aquile’s, we were shown to our rooms which were lovely, very large and had our own bathroom and shower. After being shown to our rooms, we were brought tea to help calm our systems, and given time to settle.
We met with our Maestra, Lucía Shaman Andina after this, I was delighted to learn our Maestra was a lady, as a female in a group of men, I was so happy to find this out. She was beautiful, she sang wonderfully, was very connected with nature, she had a wonderful personality and was quite funny.
During our ceremony, we were surrounded by nature after a little hike, and the second day we hiked to a beautiful waterfall and made an offering to Pachamama. Things that I prayed for began happening immediately after.
Aquiles had a beautiful voice, played many wonderful flutes, was very personable, spoke wonderful English, and had a great sense of humour as well. He communicated with the Maestra for us and translated everything. The bond between the Maestra and Aquiles was wonderful, made it easy to relax, their easy going demeaner with one another was perfect for the environment we had hoped for.
Huachuma was hard on my stomach, however I anticipated this. I felt my body was what required the healing, they were so helpful in my recovery for this, from specialty teas, special fruits and suggestions on how to recover.
From the moment of first inquiry to the moment we left Peru many days later we were treated so amazingly, the ceremony, Maestra and staff were wonderful. I highly recommend the Healing Tree Center if you are considering working with any plant medicine experiences. I know they offer more than just San Pedro (Huachuma).

Ich habe die Tour zur Lagune Huaypo und den Salzminen gebucht. Die Strecke an sich wäre sehr schön und es gäbe viele tolle Fotomotive. Entgegen der Beschreibung,zahlreiche Fotostopps zu machen, bleibt man nur 3x stehen und nur ein Fotostopp bietet ein schönes Motiv. Ich habe den Guide auch angesprochen ,warum wir nicht bei den tollen Fotospots anhalten. Er sagte,das komme noch. Von wegen! Am unverschämtesten fand ich, dass man bei einem Restaurant an der Lagune für 25 Minuten anhielt, obwohl es dort am allerhässlichsten war und dann auch noch 5 Soles pro Person zahlen musste. Ich wollte nicht bezahlen,da ich sagte,dass es hier nichts zu sehen gibt. Der Guide sagte, dass müsse jeder bezahlen,das sei für die Community. In Wahrheit war es der Eintritt für einen Bootssteg,sonst nichts. Die Quadtour dauerte insgesamt 1 Stunde 45 Minuten, davon stand man 25 Minuten einfach nur herum. Außer auf dem Steg konnte man nirgends herumlaufen.
Auf dem Weg zu den Salzminen mussten wir dann wieder eine halbe Stunde in einem Souvenirshop verbringen,wo der Guide selbst eine mehrminütige Verkaufspräsentation durchführte. Achja, ganz am Anfang musste jeder noch 3 Soles zahlen, auch für die Community. Auch wenn das nicht viel ist, das geht so nicht.Insgesamt eine halbe Kaffeefahrt ohne Möglichkeit die Schönheit der Lagune zu fotografieren. In dieser Form ist die Tour nicht zu empfehlen.

text:
Christian approached us outside the entrance to the site and helped with our purchasing of the tickets (before we even agreed to hire him as a guide) which was a great help.

At this point he offered his services and on entering the site he gave us a choice of 3 different routes and prices.

We always want to do as much as possible so opted for the longest tour of 2hr 30 mins. ( we are mid 60s, reasonably fit, I have asthma)

The steps up to the ruins are easy to negotiate; if not tiring with the altitude but Christian stopped at different terraces and used these stops to fill us in on all the history.

His English is superb and you can tell he treats this with a passion which is always great to hear.
We learnt so much.

He took so many photos of us at various stops and even managed to make me look good (ish😁)

After ascending the ruins we spent quite a while at the top and he pointed out another ruins behind the football pitch, (which we visited in the afternoon) .

On the steady decent he also stopped a few times.

We then visited the lower ruins with more photo stops and we finished off with the Llamas and Alpacas.

We can honestly say this was one of   ( if not the ) best descriptive tours we have ever had.

When it came to payment we were a little short on Soles and Dollars but this was not a problem as his brother has a shop where we could pay by card.

This part is what really confirmed how great and trusting the Peruvian people are.

There was a festival going on that day and his brother was involved, meaning the shop was shut.

Christian told us no problem and that we could arrange to meet him later on to pay!!!!

We exchanged phone numbers and returned later to settle up.
We did tip in soles cash.

If you are in doubt about who to use in Ollantaytambo look no further.

Thank you again Christian 👏👏👏

text:
I was looking for a guide in front of the Ollantaytambo archeological ruins and met Christian there. He spoke English fluently and provided some information on how to enter the site. After some chatting, we decided to hire him to tour the Ollantaytambo ruins and it was our best decision ever. Christian is very good at sharing the history of the site and information on the Inca culture through very good story telling. He kept us engaged for over 1.5 hours with all the stories and information about Inca history and culture. He was born and raised in Ollantaytambo and we particularly enjoyed hearing the local’s perspective of the archeological site and town.

We enjoyed his guiding service so much that we hired him for a full day Sacred Valley tour the next day, starting from Ollantaytambo and ending in Cusco. He made arrangements for a private air conditioned vehicle that fit all our luggage and seated us comfortably. The price he quoted was very reasonable. We stopped at Moray, Maras, Chinchero and at Sacsayhuaman before being dropped off at the hotel in Cusco. In my opinion, hiring a guide is a must because of the rich history of the Incas. He pointed out many things we would not have recognized ourselves, such as location of water channels, archeological discoveries, and including a visit to a tunnel at Sacsayhuaman. I highly recommend the guide Christian and the team of tour guides that he works with.

text:
I joined the 4-day Collpa de Guacamayos & Sandoval Lake tour with Andean Top Expeditions, and it was an unforgettable journey into the Amazon. The entire trip was very well coordinated, which allowed me to simply enjoy the experience without worrying about logistics.

Each day brought something special: the macaw clay lick was truly breathtaking, with hundreds of macaws filling the sky in a burst of color and sound. At Sandoval Lake, we had the chance to see monkeys leaping through the trees, giant otters swimming close to our boat, and caimans resting along the shoreline — moments that felt straight out of a documentary.

The lodges were cozy and clean, offering a comfortable stay while still being surrounded by the jungle. The meals were delicious and plentiful, always fresh and full of flavor. Our guide was excellent, combining deep knowledge of the Amazon with a genuine passion for sharing it.

Overall, the tour offered the perfect balance of adventure, wildlife encounters, and relaxation. I can confidently say that Andean Top Expeditions delivers a truly authentic Amazon experience that I would recommend to any traveler.

I didn't take many photos, I just enjoyed the experience.

One big highlight is that besides speaking Spanish, English, and very good Portuguese, César speaks Quechua, which allowed for a communication with the local people. It was a very special and meaningful trip that we’ll always remember.
I also want to mention our driver, Daniel, who was very careful and efficient behind the wheel, always taking good care of us. They make the perfect team! I highly recommend them.

El viaje me ha encantado,he viajado mucho, y  en este país de cumbres increíbles, su legado histórico, el trato de sus gentes siempre amables con los venimos de fuera, su gastronomía exquisita, todo un acierto  de país para pasar una vacaciones.
Por eso solo me queda agradecer a Tierra de los Andes, como agencia el viaje que me organizaron.
El viaje tenía muchos traslados, muchas estancias en hoteles distintos, actividad distintas como montar en barcos, avionetas, buggies por el desierto,guías, etc. Y todo salió bien, ningún retraso, todo a su hora, ningún espera y todo organizado.
Un 10 para Sharon nuestra guía organizadora, siempre disponible para nosotros y pendiente de que todo saliera bien. Sharon escelente profesional y pedirte perdón si fuimos algo pesados sobre algunas dudas, que solucionaste todas..
Totalmente recomendable como agencia para los que quieran visitar este país.

text:
Durante 7 días, José Luis no solo fue nuestro guía turístico, sino también un verdadero embajador de la cultura peruana. Su profundo conocimiento de la historia, su pasión por cada detalle y su manera de transmitir el significado de cada lugar transformaron completamente nuestra experiencia. Cada sitio arqueológico, cada carretera y cada rincón que visitamos cobraba vida a través de sus explicaciones.

Más allá de su profesionalismo impecable, destaca su calidad humana: siempre respetuoso, atento y genuinamente interesado en que viviéramos algo especial. Supo recomendarnos excelentes restaurantes, adaptarse a nuestro ritmo y hacernos sentir en confianza en todo momento. Al final del viaje, no solo nos llevamos recuerdos inolvidables, sino también la sensación de haber hecho un gran amigo.

Si están considerando visitar Cusco, no duden en contactar a José Luis Aguilar Bravo. Su trabajo va mucho más allá de un tour: crea experiencias que se quedan con uno para toda la vida.

Altamente recomendado.
Jorge Blanco

Had an amazing experience on the Inca trail with Marco (tour guide), Guillermo (chef) and his team of porters.
Marco was an incredibly funny and engaging guide and all round honest good guy.
The food was delicious and it was unbelievable how the Guillermo and his team could prepare such intricate hot meals (4 course dinners!!) with limited equipment in the rain
We chose evolution treks for their ethical treatment of porters. We knew we would have to rely on porters to complete the trek but didn’t want to feel exploitative. So it was great to see that the porters were happy and well looked after with professional backpacks and shoes and appropriate weight limits for their packs. Our team also had two female porters who were incredible.
10/10 would recommend evolution treks!

text: I had a wonderful experience with this company! I should maybe note that some of the equipment could be considered for replacement, as my tent was saturated with water and started to let droplets through after a night of heavy rain; I also had a sleeping bag with a crooked zipper. The porters were hardworking and cheerful, and it was nice to see inclusiveness for female porters as well.

text:
My boyfriend, parents and I went on a 4-day trek on the Inca Trail to Machu Picchu. I cannot emphasize enough how wonderful the experience was. Here are some details:

The Crew:  we had about 11 porters for our group of 4. They carried hundreds of lbs of supplies on their backs. SO talented and so kind. We all played cards on a couple of the nights.

The Guide:  Our guide, Jacob, was fantastic. Extremely knowledgeable and patient. He kept us motivated and interested the whole time.

The Food:  Felix was our wonderful chef. He cooked us 5-star food using a tent and a camp stove! Some of the best food I’ve had, full stop. All Peruvian and very accommodating of dietary preferences. He even baked us a cake at camp!

The Hike:  Not gonna sugar-coat it, the hike is tough. My parents (ages 69 and 67) both are in very good shape for their age but still struggled with the ascent. Be ready for lots of steps, constantly-changing weather, and inexplicably beautiful views of the Andes.

text: Los tours en bici que ofrece Alternative Bike Perú son increíbles! Hice un tour con Alberto quien fue un guía estupendo. La ruta que hicimos duró más o menos 4 horas y fue una combinación perfecta de ciudad y montaña. Empezamos el tour explorando el sur de Cusco. Después subimos en coche para llegar más arriba, hasta Huayllarcocha. Aquí empezó mi parte favorita de la ruta: una bajada por campos de papas, colimas verdes, pueblos pequeños, y paisajes impresionantes. Andar en bici en la altura de Cusco suena de locos, pero no lo es. Para mí, un ciclista de Holanda que no se acostumbró a andar en bici por las montañas, fue muy posible y lo disfruté al cien. Había un par de subidas más retadores, pero son pocas y también puedes subir caminando. Además, el tour no es nada competitivo. Puedes tomar fotos y pausar cuando quieras. Durante estas pausas Alberto me contó sobre la historia de Perú, así que aprendí mucho. Con un guía tan simpático como Alberto, las horas pasan volando. Si tienes dos hasta cuatro horas libres en Cusco y buscas una actividad activa, inolvidable e impresionante, recomiendo 100% reservar un tour con Alternative Bike Perú! Para mí, el tour en bici fue el que convirtió mi estancia en Cusco en una estancia fantástica.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Me and my wife booked a bike tour through the sacred valley during the rainy season in Peru. We had the best luck with the weather during our whole trip. text:
We recently returned from a two-week adventure in Peru organized by Amazonas Explorer, and it was nothing short of extraordinary. From start to finish, the trip was flawlessly executed and thoughtfully tailored to meet our specific needs and pace. Whether it was the gentle start to the Inca Trail to help with altitude, the high-quality accommodations, or the balance of activity and rest, every detail showed how much care went into planning our journey.

The highlight, of course, was hiking the Inca Trail with our incredible guide, José Rivas, whose deep knowledge and calm presence made each step more meaningful. The entire support team—our cook, porters, and crew—provided not just logistics, but genuine hospitality that made us feel completely cared for. After the hike, Amazonas Explorer kept the magic going with a stunning train ride aboard the Andean Explorer across the high plains to Lake Titicaca. There, we explored the floating Uros Islands and Taquile Island, adding a whole new cultural dimension to our adventure.

Amazonas Explorer delivered an unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime experience—from mountain passes above the clouds to peaceful moments on the highest navigable lake in the world. We’re incredibly grateful for everything they put into making this trip so personal, rich, and memorable.

text:
We had an absolutely fantastic experience with Inca Highland and cannot thank Daniela and her team enough for their outstanding service! From start to finish, everything was perfectly organized, making our trip to Cusco truly unforgettable.

Even before our trip began, Daniela was incredibly helpful. She was always quick to respond, very polite, informative, and transparent about pricing, and answered all our questions in detail. She made sure we had all the necessary information and provided helpful recommendations, which made the booking process smooth and stress-free. Her professionalism gave us confidence that we were in good hands.

We booked two services: airport transfers and a one-day private tour to the Rainbow Mountains of Palccoyo. Both airport transfers were seamless—our pick-ups and drop-offs were right on time, with no delays at all. It was a stress-free way to start and end our journey.

The highlight, of course, was our private tour to the Rainbow Mountains of Palccoyo. We were picked up very early in the morning by our driver, Elvis, and our guide, Carlos. The van was in excellent condition—comfortable and well-maintained—which made the long drive much more pleasant. Since it was a private tour, we could even catch some extra sleep on the way to our first stop.

Our first break was at Colca Buffet Restaurant, where we enjoyed a wide variety of delicious breakfast options, fresh fruits, and plenty of coca and muña tea to help with the altitude. From there, the real adventure began as we left the paved road and continued on a rocky dirt path leading up to the mountains. A little tip: bring a neck pillow! The bumpy ride can be tough on your neck, but the stunning scenery made up for it. We passed through picturesque landscapes with endless potato terraces and herds of alpacas and llamas.

Carlos did an amazing job explaining the different crops, plants, and animals we encountered along the way, making the journey even more interesting. Once we arrived at the Palccoyo Rainbow Mountains, the breathtaking views were well worth the effort. If you’re not used to high altitudes, be prepared—you might need oxygen shots! Thankfully, Carlos was always prepared with an oxygen tank, just in case.

On the way back, we made a quick detour to Circuito los Tres Puentes, which was also a beautiful and interesting stop. Then, we returned to Colca Buffet Restaurant for a delicious lunch before heading back to Cusco.

All in all, this was a five-star experience, and we are so glad we chose Inca Highland. If you’re looking for a reliable, well-organized travel agency in Cusco, we highly recommend them! A huge thank you to Daniela, Carlos, Elvis, and the entire team for making our trip so special. We would book with them again in a heartbeat!

text:
Amazing two-week trip in Peru and Bolivia

Three of my friends and I decided to travel for two weeks in Peru and Bolivia with South Adventure Peru Tours, a completely local agency. Before making our decision, we investigated several agencies, and the only one we trusted was this company managed by Ruben and Tatiana. As soon as I sent a message, they immediately contacted us and sent us a complete and detailed itinerary that included tours in Lima, Paracas, Ica with sandboarding. Then we flew to Cusco, where we did the private city tour, the Short Inca Trail to Machu Picchu, Rainbow Mountain, Humantay Lake, Lake Titicaca in Puno, and a 4-day tour to Bolivia, from where we flew directly to Lima and then returned home.

The entire trip was well organized and planned, from our arrival in Lima to our final departure. They arranged all the private tours, allowing us the most time possible at each location and never feeling rushed. Our guides were knowledgeable about each region and spoke extensively about the Inca culture. We felt very safe and were very patient with us. Ruben and Tatiana were very efficient and attentive to all our needs. They even arranged for our hotels in each location, all with convenient locations. The entire organization exceeded our expectations, with knowledgeable guides, attentive staff, and excellent communication throughout the entire trip.

During the entire trip what we loved the most was the Inca Trail and the Machu Picchu sanctuary, it really is something magical with a spectacular view, the rest of the hikes like Rainbow Mountain and Humantay Lake were also very special although a little challenging but we were able to complete with the uphill hike, but all in all they were worth doing. Our guide Victor Hugo was incredible and extremely kind, he was our support on every tour, the places we saw throughout Cusco, Sacred Valley, Moray were truly sensational, we also got to feed some animals in each farm we visited as well as llamas and alpacas. We loved the Peruvian food, it was truly delicious and we plan to return to Peru again and without a doubt, we will get in touch with Ruben and Tatiana. We are very delighted to have hired the services of a purely Peruvian company that has a close relationship with the local people. Thank you very much for making a dream come true, we will be back soon !!
author: Google Reviewer

text:
Edit included: After arriving home, Ruben reached out requesting a review which I was happy to do. But as you can imagine, getting sorted back at home and work after a holiday is hectic. I fully understand the value of reviews and referrals to small businesses; however, the amount of follow-up and reminders I received was honestly excessive. I was asked to post on multiple social media platforms and I tagged them on my IG post and posted here on Google and then TripAdvisor. When my TA post didn't show up (was in Pending Status) I received numerous requests to re-post it. Not to mention they reached out directly to TA to inquire about my review. This is too much IMO (within the span of 2 weeks, 6 separate outreaches to post including an ask for my husband to make his own separate postings) . For me, if a client is pleased with a service, it is their choice to post/not to post and shouldn't be tracked and followed-up to such degree. My review of their services is still accurate but be aware that this post-holiday experience may also follow.

Original Post:
As the travel planner in our family, I had already planned most of our itinerary, but knew we wanted a local guide to give us the context, culture and flair needed to fully appreciate all that we would see during our adventure in Peru. I’m so glad we found Ruben and Tatiana of South Adventure Peru Tours!

From the first message to our farewell hug at the airport, Ruben and Tatiana were warm, responsive, and a true pleasure to work with. Even though we didn’t need a full-service offering, they never made us feel like “small” clients. They were generous with their advice and genuinely wanted us to make the most of our time in Peru—even for parts of our itinerary they weren’t directly managing. Ruben would check-in with us regularly to see how we adjusted to the altitude, how we were enjoying the sites and journey along the way.

They helped coordinate the Sacred Valley portion of our trip, including Pisac, Cusco, Ollantaytambo, and Machu Picchu. Our guide for most of the journey was Ernesto, and our driver was Leo—both were fantastic. Leo navigated the mountain roads with ease and efficiency, and we always felt safe with him behind the wheel. Our arrival flights were delayed, but the team was incredibly flexible. We were never rushed and had time to see everything that piqued our interest.

Ernesto has a personal connection with the Quechua culture and brought the sites to life through his stories, weaving in historical insight and answering our many questions. He was attentive to our young daughter, keeping her engaged and making sure she felt included. He also made himself our family photographer and gave our usual selfie arms a rest!

At Machu Picchu, Jorge was our guide and gave us a more academic perspective and we left in awe of the architectural and innovative genius of the people who built these massive structures up in the mountains.

If you're in search of a thoughtful, kind, responsive, and deeply knowledgeable team, consider this agency. Ruben, Tatiana, Ernesto, and Leo made our time in Peru incredibly special and we thank you for your care and hospitality!

Elegí Cusco Peru Adventure por el principal motivo de ser la única agencia que encontré ofertando de forma exclusiva los 4 sitios arqueológicos más importantes a las afueras de Cusco (Saqsayhuaman, Tambomachay, Qenqo y Pucapucara). No me interesaba visitar Qoricancha ya que lo había hecho anteriormente, y la persona de contacto de la empresa, Raúl, me dijo que no me preocupara ya que solo se visitarían esos 4 lugares.

En cuanto nos recogió el guía por la mañana, nuestra sorpresa fue ver que la primera visita fue a Qoricancha, durando más de una hora. Sin duda es un sitio espectacular, pero si lo van a incluir me lo podría haber dicho antes ya que es una visita que ya había realizado.

El ritmo del tour es rápido ya que se visitan muchos lugares, pero lo que no es entendible es que te paren más de 20 minutos en una tienda de textiles teniendo que ver las maravillas arqueológicas a toda prisa. La parada es supuestamente para "explicarte el proceso de los textiles" cuando en realidad solo quieren venderte los productos locales.

En el autobús hay también diversas paradas donde se sube gente local al autobús a venderte fragancias para mal de altura, libros, y demás.

El único motivo por el que le doy 3 estrellas es porque Linder, nuestro guía, fue magnífico y uno de los mejores guías que he visto en todo Perú, asi que como el gran conductor que tuvimos.

We are the grip it and rip it type of people so we had so so so so much fun, hitting every puddle and drifting in the mud lol. We were even discussing with the guide what ATVs are best to get because we now want one 😅 Moray was also amazing and our guide gave us some great info before letting us explore. 100/10 experience!

Only one tip to guests who are going to do this, please do not tail gate the other ATVS. The guides say keep distance between each other for a reason. text:
Nos quedamos maravilladas. Albi nos llevó durante 4 días de travesía en el corazón del Valle Sagrado. Los caballos están muy bien tratados y son muy atentos. Es una raza especial peruana y tienen un paso magnífico y muy elegante.

Los paisajes fueron mágicos cada día, muy diversos y hermosos. También comimos muy bien; los “picnics” superaron con creces nuestras expectativas, y los lugares para dormir también estaban muy bien elegidos.

La guinda del pastel es que Albi tiene un gran conocimiento y amor no solo por los caballos, sino también por la cultura de su país. Además de ser guía ecuestre, también es antropólogo de formación y compartió mucho con nosotras sobre el Perú, lo cual fue muy interesante.

En definitiva, esta cabalgata fue la manera perfecta de descubrir el Valle Sagrado, sus ruinas incas, sus habitantes, sus montañas, sus salinas y su magnífica naturaleza.

Muchas gracias de nuevo por esta hermosa experiencia!

It was Edgar’s ability to match our travel wants/needs and enhance our experiences with the hidden Peruvian gems that aren’t found in typical travel itineraries (think uncrowded hikes to Inca ruins or a 17th century home not open to the public!). Also, Luxury Cusco made the transport to/from airports and the acquisition of the multiple entrance tickets seamless. A couple of my favorite memories include not only the classical Machu Picchu, but the adjacent hike to Waynapicchu (“Stairs of Death”); the Sacred Valley’s magical vistas/hikes bordered by the Inca tiered terraces and wandering llamas (PLUS a visit to a Shaman, as well as a small private sanctuary to see the “Speckled Brown Bear” and several Condors, plus a visit to a women-run weaving community!); Cusco’s famous cathedrals and Saqsaywaman Inca site, and the City Market (NOT to be missed!); and finally, last but not least, Lima, a cosmopolitan and historical city that’s also a foodie’s Happy Place (the tour of the Inca museum of pre-Inca artifacts, and the historic 17th century home still owned by the same family were my 2 favorites). As I close this review, I have a smile on my face. Truly, this was a 5 Star trip for us…and Edgar/Luxury Cusco Tours made it MAGICALLY MEMORABLE!

text:
We can’t say enough about how incredible our guide Hernan and his team were during our once-in-a-lifetime trip to Peru. From the very first day, he went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly and that we had the most enriching experience possible.

One of the best decisions we made was hiring a local guide who was born and raised in the Sacred Valley. Hernan’s deep-rooted knowledge, cultural insight, and genuine passion for his homeland brought every site, story, and tradition to life in a way no outsider ever could. He didn’t just guide us—he welcomed us into his world.

Hernan took care of every single detail. We decided on the short hike from KM 104. He booked us Vistadome train tickets, which included entertainment and breathtaking views—something we wouldn’t have thought to request since entertainment is only in car A or B, but which became one of the highlights of our trip. He also handled all of our transportation, Inca Trail permits/arrangements, Machu Picchu entrance tickets, so we didn’t have to worry about a thing. Most impressively, when we stayed at the Belmond Sanctuary Lodge near Machu Picchu, Hernan woke up at 3:30am to wait in the first bus line in Aguas Calientes—just to make sure we were first inside with him to the site that morning and could experience its magic in solitude. That level of care is rare and truly unforgettable.

Not only is he an incredible guide, he also takes amazing photos and knows all the best spots for capturing the perfect shot—we came home with beautiful memories and stunning pictures, thanks to his eye and experience.

From Cusco to the Sacred Valley to Ollantaytambo, the Inca Trail, and Machu Picchu, Hernan was not just a guide—he was a trusted companion, storyteller, and advocate. His warmth, professionalism, and love for his country elevated every part of our journey.

If you’re traveling to this region of Peru, hire someone local like Hernan. You’ll experience the culture, history, and beauty of the Andes through the eyes of someone who calls it home—and it will change the way you see the world.

Thank you Hernan for memories that we will never ever forget. I went down a deep rabbit hole years ago and found you and I’m so happy that I did and trusted my gut that you were going to be A++++

text:
Visité la cooperativa de tejido de mujeres de G Adventures el 27 de diciembre de 2025. Sinceramente, tenía muchas ganas de visitar este lugar, ya que me gusta contribuir a la comunidad local y adquirir una bonita obra de arte o un producto artesanal. Fue una experiencia increíble y las mujeres nos recibieron de maravilla. Nos dieron una demostración completa de cómo limpian y tiñen los productos con métodos tradicionales. ¡Verlas tejer fue increíble! ¡Qué intrincado! Aceptan tarjetas, pero tuve problemas con el lector de tarjetas de mi banco y no pude comprar con tarjeta, además de no tener suficiente efectivo para comprar la manta de alpaca bebé que había elegido. Fueron 1000 soles, para que se hagan una idea, o unos 300 USD. Puede parecer mucho, pero es una pieza artesanal increíble que no encontrarán en ningún otro lugar y están apoyando enormemente a esta comunidad y manteniendo viva esta parte de su cultura. En resumen, el problema de la tarjeta bancaria. Me dejaron llevar la manta y mi guía turístico se aseguraría de que recibieran su pago a su regreso. ¡Les di un abrazo enorme por su amabilidad! El dinero me fue devuelto rápidamente al pasar por un cajero automático. Digo esto solo por decirlo. Les recomiendo llevar una buena cantidad de efectivo si están de gira y no pueden regresar fácilmente a la cooperativa si tienen problemas con la tarjeta.
Dicho esto, ¡disfruté muchísimo de este lugar! ¡Las chicas fueron maravillosas, amables y muy talentosas! ¡Consideren pasar aquí durante sus vacaciones! ¡Los productos son increíbles! :)
author: Google Reviewer

text:
Aquí les presentamos una reseña de la Cooperativa de Tejedoras Ccaccaccollo en el Valle Sagrado:

La Cooperativa de Tejedoras Ccaccaccollo es un maravilloso proyecto comunitario donde los visitantes pueden experimentar las auténticas tradiciones textiles andinas. Las mujeres demuestran todo el proceso de tejido: desde el lavado de la lana de alpaca con jabones naturales, pasando por el teñido con plantas y minerales, hasta el tejido a mano de intrincados diseños en telares tradicionales. Observar su habilidad y creatividad en acción es tanto educativo como inspirador.

La cooperativa también ofrece la oportunidad de comprar textiles artesanales de alta calidad directamente de las artesanas, garantizando un pago justo y apoyando a la comunidad local. Los precios reflejan el esfuerzo y la artesanía, pero los productos son auténticos, duraderos y únicos.

Más allá de los textiles, visitar la cooperativa también implica un intercambio cultural: se aprende sobre las tradiciones quechuas, la vida cotidiana en los Andes y la importancia de preservar el conocimiento ancestral.

En definitiva, la Cooperativa de Tejedoras Ccaccaccollo es una parada importante en el Valle Sagrado, que ofrece una mezcla de cultura, historia e impacto en la comunidad.

Comida increíblemente cara para la calidad mediocre que ofrecía. El café/restaurante en sí es bonito, pero cuando fuimos, a las 13:00, estaban poniendo música de discoteca a todo volumen.

Al sentarnos, preguntamos si podríamos comer en media hora, ya que teníamos que coger un taxi. La camarera dijo que preguntaría en el restaurante y tardó cinco minutos en volver a tomar nota de nuestro pedido. ¡Y encima tuvo la desfachatez de decirnos que si queríamos que nos atendieran rápido, serían 20 soles más!

Pedimos la comida para llevar porque ya era demasiado tarde para ir a otro sitio, pero después de cobrarnos tanto por todo, era una petición absurda.

Esto también puede ser una manía personal, pero cada vez que la camarera traía la comida, dejaba la bandeja sobre nuestra mesa, delante de nosotros, y la usaba como base para servir a otros comensales. Fue una experiencia muy extraña.

Encontrarás una gran variedad de métodos de preparación como V60, Chemex, prensa francesa y más, junto con accesorios de alta calidad para que puedas llevar la experiencia a casa y perfeccionar tu propio ritual cafetero.

text:
Mi esposo y yo nos hospedamos en El Albergue Ollantaytambo durante tres noches en una habitación Superior con balcón y, lamentablemente, no cumplió con nuestras expectativas. Si bien el hotel tiene una estética particular, la experiencia fue frustrante, especialmente considerando el alto precio en comparación con los estándares locales.

El hotel está ubicado dentro de la estación de tren. Al llegar al final de la calle, los huéspedes deben entrar o salir por la puerta de la estación. En cualquier caso, basta con indicarle al personal que se hospedan en El Albergue para que les permitan el paso.

Problema importante de infraestructura: Los edificios son antiguos y las tuberías están claramente obsoletas. Durante una ducha, la presión del agua desapareció por completo mientras estaba cubierta de champú y jabón. El agua salía a un goteo mínimo, dejándome sin agua y temblando durante aproximadamente un minuto antes de que volviera la presión suficiente para enjuagarme. Era como estar en una casa antigua donde no se pueden usar dos grifos a la vez; tal vez alguien más se duchó al mismo tiempo, algo totalmente inaceptable para un hotel de este precio.

Privacidad vs. Vistas: Nos alojamos en un edificio de dos plantas con cuatro habitaciones; la nuestra era la primera de arriba. Si bien hay una bonita vista exterior, no se puede disfrutar si se busca privacidad. Debido a la distribución del edificio, los huéspedes de la habitación contigua ven directamente dentro de la nuestra cada vez que pasan. Para evitar que nos vean, hay que mantener las persianas cerradas, lo que deja la habitación a oscuras y bloquea por completo la vista, lo único "bueno" de la habitación. No todas las habitaciones tienen este problema, pero la nuestra sí.

Apagón: Una mañana, cuando fuimos a desayunar, no había luz en el comedor. Aunque había suficiente luz natural para ver, el personal tardó más de 30 minutos en restablecer la electricidad después de que llegáramos, y no sabemos cuánto tiempo llevaba sin funcionar mientras los huéspedes intentaban comer.

Ruido: Al estar ubicado justo al lado de la estación de tren, el ruido puede ser un factor. Nuestra habitación no estaba tan mal. Solo nos despertó el tren una vez por la noche.

La habitación: La habitación era básica. Aunque espaciosa, la habitación carece de la comodidad y las comodidades modernas que uno esperaría a este precio. Había muchos insectos tanto dentro como fuera de la habitación, probablemente debido a que se encuentra en una zona rural y al mes en que estuvimos allí.

text: Si eres del Reino Unido y te gusta el pollo con patatas fritas, este es tu sitio. La broaster estaba jugosa, la masa crujiente y bien sazonada. No te pierdas el salchi, está delicioso. ¡Menuda experiencia culinaria! 10/10, no te lo pierdas.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Nos lo recomendó el propietario del hotel donde nos alojábamos cuando le preguntamos por un restaurante local, ya que no deseábamos los restaurantes para turistas de la plaza. Y fue un acierto! Salchipapas sabrosas excelentes y amabilidad del personal y esta justo al lado de la plaza de armas y barato. Lo recomiendo!
author: Google Reviewer

text: Delicioso y asequible 👍 para todos aquellos que no quieren pagar una fortuna por restaurantes turísticos excesivamente caros.
author: Google Reviewer

text:
Después de probar más de 10 platillos en los restaurantes locales de Aguas Calientes y el Mercado de San Pedro en Cusco,

¡este restaurante los superó a todos! Por el precio local de 14.5 soles, la comida está por encima de lo esperado.

El pollo estaba sabroso y jugoso, las papas fritas crujientes por fuera y suaves por dentro, y la ensalada y la salsa, simplemente perfectas.

¡Cinco estrellas sin duda!
author: Google Reviewer

text:
¡Comida local increíble! Si eres turista y buscas una experiencia auténtica, ¡ven aquí! La comida estaba buenísima y el servicio fue perfecto. Además, el menú del día tiene un precio muy asequible.

(Asegúrate de ir a Doña Eva, a la izquierda).
author: Google Reviewer

text: Un pequeño y encantador restaurante típico peruano. Ofrecen comida tradicional con un servicio y precios excelentes. Nos recibieron con una cálida bienvenida y un servicio rápido. Está a solo unos pasos de la plaza, en dirección al mercado.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Deliciosa combinación de pollería y chifa. Muchos lugareños, servicio súper amable. No sé qué hierbas usaron en el pollo, pero eran nuevas para mí y estaban increíbles. Precio muy razonable. Recomiendo este lugar.
author: Google Reviewer

text:
Un lugar muy acogedor, cómodo y bonito la comida y dulces súper delicioso 💖
el fresón es mi favorito🥹
author: Google Reviewer

text:
Es ideal para desayunar; los panqueques de frutas son increíbles.

El desayuno de 30 soles con aguacate, tomates, frijoles con espinacas, calabacín y frijoles es fantástico.

Lo recomiendo ampliamente para el desayuno.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Había muchas opciones veganas. Pedí los panqueques, que eran muy abundantes y deliciosos. Me senté en el balcón y tenía una vista preciosa. El personal fue muy amable, no me metieron prisa en absoluto.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Las MEJORES EMPANADAS DE POLLO QUE HE PROBADO, TODO DELICIOSO. EL TRATO ES MUY AMABLE, ÉL AMBIENTE CÁLIDO. MUCHAS GRACIAS. VOLVERÉ A REGRESAR.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Desayuné aquí antes de visitar las ruinas. Un lugar encantador con dos pisos y vistas a las calles. Pedí el desayuno número 2 (sin nombre), estaba delicioso por 25 soles y la porción era generosa. Además, incluía café y jugo de naranja. ¡Volveré a comer aquí! Lo recomiendo totalmente para desayunar.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Tuve una experiencia fenomenal en esta cafetería. Mi café con leche estaba increíble y el ambiente era genial. Los baristas fueron increíblemente amables, acogedores y serviciales. ¡Una cafetería para recordar!
author: Google Reviewer

text: ¡El mejor sándwich de kimchi que he probado en mi vida! Vinimos tres mañanas seguidas porque está buenísimo. Además, pedimos flat whites todas las veces, que estaban riquísimos.
author: Google Reviewer

text: Sandwichs abundantes y café rico. Buena vista
author: Google Reviewer

text: Esta tarde disfrutamos de un buen almuerzo. Pedimos un sándwich, una galleta de hojas de coca y dos cafés. El café estaba rico, no ácido como en otros sitios. La habitación de arriba es muy bonita: minimalista, con dos asientos junto a la ventana que nos gustaron mucho. La recomendamos.
author: Google Reviewer

text: ¡Excelente café, precio razonable para un café de especialidad, el sándwich mixto era abundante, la decoración es agradable y el ambiente es bueno!

text: Un lugar 100 % recomendado , la comida deliciosa y la vista que tiene es muy hermosa , si estas apunto de tomar tu tren , este lugar es el indicado para poder esperar.

text: Yuliana hace los mejores pisco sours. La atención fue espectacular. Gracias Yuliana!!!
